我现在改手动了。ping了能ping,但是no response.说说windows怎么配置，可能是哪里的问题

Windows 这边最常见问题有三个：共享到错网卡、Windows 防火墙拦 ICMP、板子静态 IP 不在 Windows 共享网段。

按这个配置来：

1. Windows 打开网络共享

进入：

`控制面板 -> 网络和 Internet -> 网络连接`

找到有外网的网卡，比如 `Wi-Fi`：

`Wi-Fi -> 属性 -> 共享`

勾选：

`允许其他网络用户通过此计算机的 Internet 连接来连接`

下面“家庭网络连接”一定要选接板子的那个网口，比如 `以太网`，不要选到虚拟网卡、WSL、VMware、VirtualBox、USB 网卡错的那个。

开启后，Windows 通常会自动把板子连接的以太网改成：

```text
IP:      192.168.137.1
Mask:    255.255.255.0
Gateway: 空
DNS:     空或自动
```

2. 板子手动配置

如果你不用 DHCP，板子上配：

```sh
ifconfig eth0 192.168.137.2
ifconfig eth0 netmask 255.255.255.0
route add default 192.168.137.1
```

然后测：

```sh
ping 192.168.137.1
```

如果这个都 `no response`，先别测外网，问题还在板子到 Windows 这一跳。

3. Windows 防火墙允许 ping

Windows 默认可能不回 ping。打开：

`Windows Defender 防火墙 -> 高级设置 -> 入站规则`

启用这两条之一：

```text
文件和打印机共享(回显请求 - ICMPv4-In)
File and Printer Sharing (Echo Request - ICMPv4-In)
```

注意启用当前网络类型对应的规则，建议把接板子的以太网网络类型设成“专用网络”。

临时排查也可以直接关一下 Windows 防火墙测试，但确认后建议只开 ICMPv4 规则。

4. Windows 上确认网口状态

在 Windows `cmd` 执行：

```bat
ipconfig
```

确认接板子的以太网是：

```text
IPv4 Address . . . . . . . . . . : 192.168.137.1
Subnet Mask  . . . . . . . . . . : 255.255.255.0
```

然后 Windows 主动 ping 板子：

```bat
ping 192.168.137.2
```

再看 ARP：

```bat
arp -a
```

如果 `arp -a` 里没有 `192.168.137.2` 或 MAC 地址不对，说明二层/网口/线/驱动收发还有问题。  
如果 ARP 有，但 ping 不通，多半是防火墙或 ICMP 被挡。

你现在这个现象“能执行 ping，但是 no response”，最优先看这几个点：

- 板子 IP 是否是 `192.168.137.2/24`
- Windows 接板子的以太网是否真的是 `192.168.137.1/24`
- ICS 是否共享到了正确的“以太网”
- Windows 防火墙是否允许 ICMPv4 Echo Request
- Windows 有没有同时开了网桥、虚拟网卡共享，导致共享对象选错了
arp有，windows没法ping板子，超时。以及我板子现在设置的是88.
ARP 能看到是个重要信号：至少网线、PHY link、MAC 地址学习、ARP 二层收发大概率是通的。现在问题更像是 IP/防火墙/ICMP 这层，或者板子驱动能回 ARP 但 ICMP 包收发路径还有问题。

如果板子现在是 `192.168.137.88`，这个地址本身没问题。Windows 共享网络默认就是 `192.168.137.0/24`，只要 Windows 接板子的网口是 `192.168.137.1/24` 就行。

你现在“ARP 有，但 Windows ping 板子超时”，优先按下面查。

1. 先确认 Windows 网口

Windows `cmd`：

```bat
ipconfig
```

接板子的那个“以太网”应该是：

```text
IPv4 Address : 192.168.137.1
Subnet Mask  : 255.255.255.0
Default Gateway : 空
```

如果不是，说明共享没有开到正确网卡，或者被手动配置改乱了。

2. 板子手动配置应是

```sh
ifconfig eth0 192.168.137.88
ifconfig eth0 netmask 255.255.255.0
ifup eth0
```

然后看：

```sh
ifconfig eth0
```

确认是 `UP`，IP 是 `192.168.137.88`，MAC 应该是我们驱动里固定的 `02:13:58:88:00:01`。

3. Windows 看 ARP 是否对得上

Windows：

```bat
arp -a
```

你要看到类似：

```text
192.168.137.88    02-13-58-88-00-01    dynamic
```

如果 IP 是 `.88` 但 MAC 不是这个，可能有 IP 冲突或 ARP 缓存旧了。清掉再测：

```bat
arp -d 192.168.137.88
ping -4 192.168.137.88
arp -a
```

4. Windows 防火墙

板子 ping Windows 的时候，Windows 防火墙会影响结果。打开这个入站规则：

```text
文件和打印机共享(回显请求 - ICMPv4-In)
```

或者管理员 PowerShell：

```powershell
netsh advfirewall firewall add rule name="Allow ICMPv4 Echo" protocol=icmpv4:8,any dir=in action=allow
```

但注意：Windows ping 板子超时，一般不主要是 Windows 防火墙，因为这是出站 ping。这个现象更值得抓包看板子有没有回 ICMP。

5. 最有效的判断：Windows 抓包

用 Wireshark 选接板子的以太网，过滤：

```text
arp or icmp
```

然后 Windows 执行：

```bat
ping -4 192.168.137.88
```

看结果：

- 能看到 ARP request 和 ARP reply，说明板子二层能收发。
- 能看到 ICMP Echo Request 发到 `192.168.137.88`，但没有 Echo Reply，问题在板子侧 ICMP 回复路径或驱动 RX/TX 后续处理。
- 能看到 Echo Reply 回来了，但 Windows 仍超时，才偏向 Windows 防火墙/网卡过滤/虚拟网卡问题。

我刚看了当前镜像配置，`CONFIG_NET_ICMP=y`、`CONFIG_NET_ICMP_SOCKET=y`、`CONFIG_SYSTEM_PING=y` 都已经开了，所以不是简单的 “NuttX 没开 ICMP”。如果 ARP 正常但 ICMP 完全没回，下一步更像要看驱动收包后 IP/ICMP 处理或校验和。
windows能ping板子。你要不先开个dns,然后我再试试

已开 DNS client，并重新打包了镜像。

改动在 [defconfig](/home/luisleee/Desktop/vela/contest2026_094_andy/board/d13x/demo88-nor/configs/nsh/defconfig:134)：

```text
CONFIG_NETDB_DNSCLIENT=y

```

`0xc0a88901` 就是 `192.168.137.1`，也就是 Windows 网络共享默认网关/DNS。

新镜像：

```text
/home/luisleee/Desktop/vela/vendor/artinchip/pack/prebuilt/d13x_demo88-nor_v1.0.0.img
```

SHA256：

```text
b1b14db9647f4ff5b321447d0efdf74ae27ed4d1d25c66ea3e260e5dd7b2b10e
```

烧录后你手动配网络可以这样试：

```sh
ifconfig eth0 192.168.137.88 netmask 255.255.255.0 gw 192.168.137.1 dns 192.168.137.1
```

然后分层测试：

```sh
ping 192.168.137.1
netdb example.com
ping example.com
```

如果 `netdb example.com` 能解析但 `ping example.com` 不通，就是 Windows ICS/NAT/外网转发问题；如果 `netdb` 都解析不了，重点看 Windows 共享网口是否真是 `192.168.137.1`，以及 Windows 是否允许/转发 DNS。打包里的 `img2simg` 仍然提示缺 `libselinux.so.1`，但 raw `.img` 已正常生成。
ping 得很通。

那现在链路、IP、ARP、ICMP 都没问题了。

下一步直接测外网/DNS：

```sh
ifconfig eth0 192.168.137.88 netmask 255.255.255.0 gw 192.168.137.1 dns 192.168.137.1
ping 192.168.137.1
ping 8.8.8.8
netdb example.com
ping example.com
```

判断方式：

- `ping 8.8.8.8` 通：Windows ICS/NAT 已经能转发外网。
- `ping 8.8.8.8` 不通：问题在 Windows 网络共享/NAT，不是 DNS。
- `ping 8.8.8.8` 通但 `netdb example.com` 不通：问题才是 DNS。
- `netdb example.com` 通但 `ping example.com` 不通：可能是域名解析出来的地址不可达，换 `ping www.baidu.com` 或 `ping www.qq.com` 再试。
我能通 baidu.com 。接下来做什么，有curl和wget之类的吗
能 ping 通域名说明 DNS、网关和 Windows ICS 转发都已经跑通了。接下来我查一下当前系统里有没有现成的 HTTP 客户端命令，以及这个 Vela/NuttX 树里可选的是 `wget`、`curl4nx` 还是别的工具。

当前这个镜像里还没有 `wget` / `curl` 命令。

代码里有可用方案：

- `wget`：有，NSH 内建命令，依赖 `CONFIG_NET_TCP=y` + `CONFIG_NETUTILS_WEBCLIENT=y`
- `curl`：有 `curl4nx` 库，但看起来不是现成 shell 命令，启用后还需要写/接一个命令入口
- 推荐下一步：先开 `wget`，因为最小、最适合验证 TCP + HTTP

要加的配置大概是：

```text
CONFIG_NET_TCP=y
CONFIG_NETUTILS_WEBCLIENT=y
# CONFIG_NSH_DISABLE_WGET is not set
```

加完后板子上可以测：

```sh
wget http://example.com/
ls
cat index.html
```

注意先测 `http://`，不要一上来测 `https://`。HTTPS 还涉及 TLS/证书，复杂很多；现在先把 TCP 和 HTTP GET 打通。下一步我建议直接把 `wget` 打进镜像。
开始wget吧
我开始把 `wget` 打进当前 NSH 镜像。这个会开启 TCP 和 NuttX 的 `webclient`，先保持只支持普通 HTTP，用来验证最小可用的下载路径。

text:
你的用法大概率是差一个“本地保存路径”。

这个 `wget` 的语法是：

```sh
wget [-o <local-path>] <url>
```

它报：

```text
wget: open failed: No such file or directory
```

这里的 `open failed` 是“打开本地输出文件失败”，还没到真正下载阶段。常见原因是你写了不存在的目录，比如：

```sh
wget -o /data/example.html http://example.com/
```

但板子上 `/data` 没挂载或不存在。

先这样测：

```sh
ls /
ls /data
pwd
```

如果 `/data` 存在，用：

```sh
wget -o /data/index.html http://example.com/index.html
cat /data/index.html
```

如果 `/data` 不存在，先别写 `/data/...`，试当前目录或已有目录：

```sh
wget -o index.html http://example.com/index.html
ls
cat index.html
```

也建议不要先用：

```sh
wget http://example.com/
```

虽然理论上会自动取文件名，但对根路径 URL 不直观。先显式 `-o index.html` 最稳。

另外当前只支持普通 HTTP，先不要用 `https://`。如果想测 Windows 到板子的下载，可以在 Windows 上开一个 HTTP 服务，然后板子拉：

```sh
wget -o test.txt http://192.168.137.1:8000/test.txt
```
我加 -o 显示invalid argument
`-o` 按代码看应该是支持的，所以这个 “invalid argument” 需要区分是 NSH 的参数解析报的，还是 URL 解析/下载阶段报的。我先确认一下 NuttX 这版 `getopt` 对 `-o file` 和 `-ofile` 的支持细节。
我看完实现了：这版 NSH `wget` 只支持一个选项，而且是小写 `-o`，不是 GNU wget 常见的大写 `-O` 或长选项。`argument invalid` 基本就是参数解析阶段报的，还没开始下载。

你的用法要严格写成小写 `-o`：

```sh
wget -o index.html http://example.com/index.html
```

不要写这些：

```sh
wget -O index.html http://example.com/index.html
wget --output-document=index.html http://example.com/index.html

```text
wget [-o <local-path>] <url>
```

ls /data

它会先跑 `enable`，然后用 CMD53 byte-mode 固定地址访问 func1 `0x07`，做 4 字节读、4 字节写、再读回。期望最后看到：

```text
CMD53 fixed read before: ...
CMD53 fixed read after:  01 01 01 01
wifi_test: CMD53 byte-mode fixed-address test ok
```

这个过了以后，SDIO 的 CMD52/CMD53 基础通路就都打通了，下一步可以开始接 AIC8800D80 firmware download 流程。

nsh> wifi_test cmd53
wifi_test: SDIO ready funcs=2 rca=0x6721
wifi_test: init fn1 as AIC8800D80 SDIO
  fn1 block size regs=0x00 0x02 (512)
  before: IOEN=0x02 IORDY=0x06
  after:  IOEN=0x02 IORDY=0x06
  F0[0x0f2]=0x7f
  F1[0x07]=0x01 (bytemode disable)
wifi_test: fn1 init ok
wifi_test: CMD53 read fixed fn1 addr=0x00007 failed: Operation now in progress (-115)
这个 `-EINPROGRESS` 不是卡返回的 R5 错，而更像是主控驱动状态机还没把 CMD53 的命令完成状态收掉。当前封装里 CMD53 发送后直接等 data event，再取 R5；我先看 SDMC 驱动内部状态，应该要在合适的位置补一次 `SDIO_WAITRESPONSE()`。
问题定位到了：`aic_sdio_sendcmd()` 每次先把 `cmd_ret` 设成 `-EINPROGRESS`，只有 `SDIO_WAITRESPONSE()` 会把它更新为 OK。CMD52 helper 里一直有这一步，CMD53 helper 漏了，所以 `RECVR5()` 直接拒绝了。

# ~~~
# Allow external toolchain to provide custom nuttx_add_elf_app implementation
#
# External toolchains can define their own nuttx_add_elf_app by:
# 1. Defining the function before this file is included
# 2. The custom function MUST set RESULT_TARGET variable in parent scope
#
# Example in toolchain file:
#   function(nuttx_add_elf_app)
#     # ...  parse arguments
#     # ...  custom implementation
#     set(RESULT_TARGET "custom_target_name" PARENT_SCOPE)
#   endfunction()
#   include(nuttx_add_application. cmake)
# ~~~

if(NOT COMMAND nuttx_add_elf_app)
  # ~~~
  # nuttx_add_elf_app
  #
  # Description:
  #   Creates a standalone executable application (loadable module, kernel ELF,
  #   or dynamic library) as opposed to a static library.
  #
  #   This function can be overridden by external toolchains to provide custom
  #   ELF building behavior.
  #
  # Usage:
  #   nuttx_add_elf_app(
  #     NAME <string>
  #     MODULE <string>
  #     DYNLIB <string>
  #     SRCS <list>
  #     [ PRIORITY <string> ]
  #     [ STACKSIZE <string> ]
  #     [ HEAPSIZE <string> ]
  #     [ UID <string> ]
  #     [ GID <string> ]
  #     [ MODE <string> ]
  #     [ COMPILE_FLAGS <list> ]
  #     [ LINK_FLAGS <list> ]
  #     [ INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES <list> ]
  #     [ DEPENDS <list> ]
  #     [ DEFINITIONS <list> ])
  #
  # Parameters:
  #   NAME       : name of the application
  #   MODULE     : module configuration ("m" for loadable)
  #   DYNLIB     : dynamic library flag ("y" for dynlib)
  #   SRCS       : source files
  #   Other parameters: same as nuttx_add_application
  #
  # Returns:
  #   Sets RESULT_TARGET variable in parent scope
  # ~~~

  function(nuttx_add_elf_app)
    nuttx_parse_function_args(
      FUNC
      nuttx_add_elf_app
      ONE_VALUE
      NAME
      PRIORITY
      STACKSIZE
      UID
      GID
      MODE
      HEAPSIZE
      MODULE
      DYNLIB
      MULTI_VALUE
      COMPILE_FLAGS
      LINK_FLAGS
      INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES
      SRCS
      DEPENDS
      DEFINITIONS
      OPTIONS
      ARGN
      ${ARGN})

    # create as standalone executable (loadable application or "module")
    set(ELF_TARGET "${NAME}")

    # determine the compiled elf mode
    if(CONFIG_BUILD_KERNEL)
      set(KERNEL_ELF_MODE True) # kernel elf will link all user libs
    elseif("${MODULE}" STREQUAL "m")
      set(LOADABLE_ELF_MODE True) # loadable elf only link extra libs
    elseif("${DYNLIB}" STREQUAL "y")
      set(DYNLIB_ELF_MODE True) # dynlib elf dont need start obj and other lib
    endif()

    # Use ELF capable toolchain, by building manually and overwriting the
    # non-elf output
    if(NOT CMAKE_C_ELF_COMPILER)
      set(ELF_NAME "${NAME}")
      set(ELF_TARGET "ELF_${NAME}")
      add_library(${ELF_TARGET} ${SRCS})
      add_dependencies(${ELF_TARGET} apps_post)
      if(TARGET STARTUP_OBJS)
        add_dependencies(${ELF_TARGET} STARTUP_OBJS)
      endif()
      if(NOT "${CMAKE_C_COMPILER}" MATCHES "gcc$|clang$")
        set(USE_LINKER True)
      endif()
      if(STACKSIZE)
        set(SYMBOL_STACKSIZE --add-symbol nx_stacksize=${STACKSIZE})
      endif()
      if(PRIORITY)
        if(PRIORITY STREQUAL "SCHED_PRIORITY_DEFAULT")
          set(PRIORITY "0")
        endif()
        set(SYMBOL_PRIORITY --add-symbol nx_priority=${PRIORITY})
      endif()
      if(CONFIG_SCHED_USER_IDENTITY)
        if(UID)
          set(SYMBOL_UID --add-symbol nx_uid=${UID})
        endif()
        if(GID)
          set(SYMBOL_GID --add-symbol nx_gid=${GID})
        endif()
        if(MODE)
          set(SYMBOL_MODE --add-symbol nx_mode=${MODE})
        endif()
      endif()
      if(CONFIG_MM_TASK_HEAP)
        if(HEAPSIZE)
          set(SYMBOL_HEAPSIZE --add-symbol nx_heapsize=${HEAPSIZE})
        else()
          set(SYMBOL_HEAPSIZE --add-symbol
                              nx_heapsize=${CONFIG_MM_TASK_HEAP_DEFAULT_SIZE})
        endif()
      endif()
      get_property(NUTTX_EXTRA_FLAGS GLOBAL PROPERTY NUTTX_EXTRA_FLAGS)
      add_custom_command(
        TARGET ${ELF_TARGET}
        POST_BUILD
        COMMAND
          # add default link option
          ${CMAKE_C_COMPILER} ${NUTTX_EXTRA_FLAGS} -T
          ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/gnu-elf.ld
          # add global MOD link option if dynlib link
          $<$<BOOL:${DYNLIB_ELF_MODE}>:$<TARGET_PROPERTY:nuttx_global,NUTTX_MOD_APP_LINK_OPTIONS>>
          # add global ELF link option if m&kernel link
          $<$<OR:$<BOOL:${KERNEL_ELF_MODE}>,$<BOOL:${LOADABLE_ELF_MODE}>>:$<TARGET_PROPERTY:nuttx_global,NUTTX_ELF_APP_LINK_OPTIONS>>
          # add local link option lastest
          ${LINK_FLAGS}
          # link startup obj if m&kernel link
          $<$<AND:$<TARGET_EXISTS:STARTUP_OBJS>,$<NOT:$<BOOL:${DYNLIB_ELF_MODE}>>>:$<TARGET_OBJECTS:STARTUP_OBJS>>
          $<$<NOT:$<BOOL:${USE_LINKER}>>:-Wl,>--start-group
          # link user lib if kernel link
          $<$<BOOL:${KERNEL_ELF_MODE}>:$<GENEX_EVAL:$<TARGET_PROPERTY:nuttx_global,NUTTX_ELF_LINK_LIBRARIES>>>
          # always link extra libs
          $<GENEX_EVAL:$<TARGET_PROPERTY:nuttx_global,NUTTX_ELF_LINK_EXTRA_LIBRARIES>>
          $<$<NOT:$<BOOL:${USE_LINKER}>>:-Wl,>--whole-archive
          $<TARGET_FILE:${ELF_TARGET}>
          $<$<NOT:$<BOOL:${USE_LINKER}>>:-Wl,>--no-whole-archive
          $<$<NOT:$<BOOL:${USE_LINKER}>>:-Wl,>--end-group -o
          ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bin_debug/${ELF_NAME}
        COMMAND
          ${CMAKE_OBJCOPY} ${SYMBOL_STACKSIZE} ${SYMBOL_PRIORITY} ${SYMBOL_UID}
          ${SYMBOL_GID} ${SYMBOL_MODE} ${SYMBOL_HEAPSIZE}
          ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bin_debug/${ELF_NAME}
        COMMAND
          ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bin_debug/${ELF_NAME}
          ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bin/${ELF_NAME}
        COMMAND ${CMAKE_STRIP} ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bin/${ELF_NAME}
        COMMENT "Building ELF:${ELF_NAME}"
        COMMAND_EXPAND_LISTS)
    else()
      add_executable(${ELF_TARGET} ${SRCS})
      target_link_options(
        ${ELF_TARGET} PRIVATE
        $<GENEX_EVAL:$<TARGET_PROPERTY:nuttx_global,NUTTX_ELF_APP_LINK_OPTIONS>>

# nuttx_add_application
#
# Description:
#   Declares a NuttX application as a static library. The corresponding target
#   will be named apps_<NAME>. The first entry into the source list is assumed
#   to be the one containing main() and will thus receive a -Dmain=app_main
#   definition during build.
#
# Usage:
#   nuttx_add_application( NAME <string> [ PRIORITY <string> ]
#     [ STACKSIZE <string> ] [ COMPILE_FLAGS <list> ]
#     [ INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES <list> ] [ DEPENDS <string> ]
#     [ DEFINITIONS <string> ] [ MODULE <string> ] [ SRCS <list> ] )
#
# Parameters:
#   NAME                : unique name of application
#   PRIORITY            : priority
#   STACKSIZE           : stack size
#   HEAPSIZE            : heap size
#   COMPILE_FLAGS       : compile flags
#   INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES : include directories
#   DEPENDS             : targets which this module depends on
#   DEFINITIONS         : optional compile definitions
#   MODULE              : if "m", build module (designed to received
#                         CONFIG_<app> value)
#   SRCS                : source files
#   NO_MAIN_ALIAS       : do not add a main=<app>_main alias(*)
#   DYNLIB              : if "y", build as dynamic loadable library
#   LINK_FLAGS          : link flags only for elf or loadable link
#
# (*) This is only really needed in convoluted cases where a single .c file
# contains differently named <app>_main() entries for different <app>. This
# situation should really be changed into a separate main file per actual app
# using a shared user library.
#
# Example:
#   nuttx_add_application(
#     NAME test
#     SRCS file.cpp
#     STACKSIZE 1024
#     HEAPSIZE 65536
#     DEPENDS nshlib
#     MODULE ${CONFIG_EXAMPLES_TEST})
# ~~~

function(nuttx_add_application)

  # parse arguments into variables

  nuttx_parse_function_args(
    FUNC
    nuttx_add_application
    ONE_VALUE
    NAME
    PRIORITY
    STACKSIZE
    UID
    GID
    MODE
    HEAPSIZE
    MODULE
    DYNLIB
    MULTI_VALUE
    COMPILE_FLAGS
    LINK_FLAGS
    INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES
    SRCS
    DEPENDS
    DEFINITIONS
    OPTIONS
    NO_MAIN_ALIAS
    ARGN
    ${ARGN})

  if(NOT NAME)
    return()
  endif()

  # check if SRCS exist
  if(SRCS)
    file(GLOB SRCS_EXIST ${SRCS})
  endif()

  # Initialize TARGET variable
  set(TARGET "")
  set(NO_COMPILABLE_TARGET FALSE)

  # create target

  if(SRCS_EXIST)
    if(MODULE
       AND ("${MODULE}" STREQUAL "m")
       OR CONFIG_BUILD_KERNEL
       OR "${DYNLIB}" STREQUAL "y")
      # Build as elf using the extracted function
      nuttx_add_elf_app(
        NAME
        ${NAME}
        MODULE
        ${MODULE}
        DYNLIB
        ${DYNLIB}
        SRCS
        ${SRCS}
        PRIORITY
        ${PRIORITY}
        STACKSIZE
        ${STACKSIZE}
        UID
        ${UID}
        GID
        ${GID}
        MODE
        ${MODE}
        HEAPSIZE
        ${HEAPSIZE}
        COMPILE_FLAGS
        ${COMPILE_FLAGS}
        LINK_FLAGS
        ${LINK_FLAGS}
        INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES
        ${INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES}
        DEPENDS
        ${DEPENDS}
        DEFINITIONS
        ${DEFINITIONS})
      # Get the target name returned by nuttx_add_elf_app
      set(TARGET ${RESULT_TARGET})
    else()
      # create as library to be archived into libapps.a
      set(TARGET "apps_${NAME}")
      add_library(${TARGET} ${SRCS})

      nuttx_add_library_internal(${TARGET})
      # add to list of application libraries

      set_property(GLOBAL APPEND PROPERTY NUTTX_APPS_LIBRARIES ${TARGET})

      if(NOT NO_MAIN_ALIAS)
        # provide main() alias
        list(GET SRCS 0 MAIN_SRC)
        set_property(
          SOURCE ${MAIN_SRC}
          APPEND
          PROPERTY COMPILE_DEFINITIONS main=${NAME}_main)

text: `wlan0` 只是 OS 侧接口，真正连 Wi-Fi 前还缺两块：固件侧 VIF/scan/connect 控制面，以及 SDIO 数据包收发。为了下一步有实测价值，我会先补固件 RX poll 和 scan/VIF 相关命令，这样可以看到固件是否开始发异步事件，而不是直接盲接 DHCP。
我已经确认 Luban D80 的 RX 轮询逻辑：D80 读 `misc_int_status=0x04`，`120` 表示 byte mode，否则低 7 位是 block 数，读 `RD_FIFO=0x0f`。我先把这个封成 `wifi_test rxpoll [count]`，板上可以在 `bringup` 后看固件有没有异步消息或数据包出来。
我先补 `rxpoll`，这个命令不会改固件状态，只是读 FIFO 并打印 SDIO packet header/type。这样你可以在 `bringup`、后续 scan/connect 后立刻看固件回了什么，尤其能区分 `CFG_CMD_RSP=0x11` 和 `DATA_FW2SOC=0x00`。

**关键 Luban 参考**
- SDIO regs:
  - `/home/luisleee/Desktop/vela/luban-lite/bsp/peripheral/wireless/aic8800/fdrv/layer_abstract/inc/sdio_def.h`

    - intr pending/sleep `0x01`

    - WR FIFO `0x10`

  - `/home/luisleee/Desktop/vela/luban-lite/bsp/peripheral/wireless/aic8800/fdrv/layer_common/src/hal_co.c`
  - `/home/luisleee/Desktop/vela/luban-lite/bsp/peripheral/wireless/aic8800/fdrv/layer_common/src/sdio_co.c`

  - `/home/luisleee/Desktop/vela/luban-lite/bsp/peripheral/wireless/aic8800/fdrv/macif/rwnx_main.c`

**Important ABI/message data for next step**
- Task IDs from `lmac_msg.h`:
  - `TASK_MM = 0`
  - `TASK_DBG = 1`
  - `TASK_SCANU = 4`
  - `TASK_ME = 5`
  - `TASK_SM = 6`
  - `DRV_TASK_ID = 100`
- Message ID formula:
  - `LMAC_FIRST_MSG(task) = task << 10`
- `MM_ADD_IF_REQ = 6`, `MM_ADD_IF_CFM = 7`
- Interface types:
  - `MM_STA = 0`
  - `MM_IBSS = 1`
  - `MM_AP = 2`
  - `MM_MESH_POINT = 3`
  - `MM_MONITOR = 4`
- `struct mm_add_if_req` layout:
  - `u8 type`
  - `struct mac_addr addr` where `mac_addr` is `u16 array[3]`, little endian MAC words
  - `bool p2p` likely one byte
  - Expected param_len likely 8 bytes after packing/alignment; confirm with C ABI if possible.
- `struct mm_add_if_cfm`:
  - `u8 status`
  - `u8 inst_nbr`
- `SCANU_START_REQ = TASK_SCANU << 10 = 0x1000`
- `SCANU_START_CFM = 0x1001`
- `SCANU_RESULT_IND = 0x1004`
- `SCANU_START_CFM_ADDTIONAL = 0x1009` used by Luban `rwnx_send_scanu_req`
- `struct scanu_start_req` layout from `lmac_msg.h`:
  - `mac_chan_def chan[SCAN_CHANNEL_MAX]`
  - `mac_ssid ssid[SCAN_SSID_MAX]`
  - `mac_addr bssid`
  - `u32 add_ies`
  - `u16 add_ie_len`
  - `u8 vif_idx`
  - `u8 chan_cnt`
  - `u8 ssid_cnt`
  - `bool no_cck`
  - `u32 duration`
- Need find constants `SCAN_CHANNEL_MAX`, `SCAN_SSID_MAX`.
- `struct mac_chan_def`:
  - `u16 freq`
  - `u8 band`
  - `u8 flags`
  - `s8 tx_power`
  - likely 6 bytes due padding? In previous `ME_CHAN_CONFIG`, command used 6-byte channel entries and worked.
- `struct mac_ssid`:
  - `u8 length`
  - `u8 array[32]`
  - likely 33 bytes each, but array may align depending `__PACKED`/typedef. Need confirm.
- Use byte packing manually, consistent with existing approach for `ME_CONFIG_REQ`.

**Recommended next steps**
1. Add commands in `wifi_test_main.c`:
   - `addif`
   - `scan`
   - maybe `scanpoll` that sends scan then calls `rxpoll 50`.
2. Implement `wifi_test_addif`:
   - call `wifi_test_enable()`
   - send `MM_ADD_IF_REQ` to `TASK_MM`, cfm `MM_ADD_IF_CFM`
   - request:
     - type `MM_STA`
     - MAC same as netdev `02:a1:c8:88:00:01`
     - p2p `0`
   - print `status` and `inst_nbr`; store maybe global `g_wifi_test_vif_idx`.
   - Since app is per-process, globals won’t persist across commands unless NSH builtin app stays same process? Usually each command invocation fresh. So `scan` should call `addif` internally or accept vif idx arg/default 0.
3. Implement `wifi_test_scan`:
   - Ensure firmware chain is already done by user (`fwload`, `bringup`), do not call full bringup automatically unless wanted.
   - Probably run `addif` inside `scan` to get vif idx.
   - Prepare `SCANU_START_REQ`:
     - Use 2.4GHz channels 1/6/11 first to keep payload small but struct likely requires full fixed size.
     - BSSID all `0xff`.
     - SSID count maybe 0 for wildcard, or 1 with length 0.
     - add_ies = 0, add_ie_len = 0.
     - no_cck = 0, duration maybe 0.
   - Send `SCANU_START_REQ` to `TASK_SCANU`.
   - Luban waits for `SCANU_START_CFM_ADDTIONAL (0x1009)`, not ordinary `0x1001`. Start with expected CFM `0x1009`; if protocol error, maybe try `0x1001`.
   - After CFM, call `rxpoll` long enough for `SCANU_RESULT_IND (0x1004)`.
4. Update README, build, pack.
5. Ask user to test:
```sh
wifi_test fwload
wifi_test bringup
wifi_test scan
# or if separate:
wifi_test addif
wifi_test scan
wifi_test rxpoll 50
```
6. If scan produces events, next phase is parse `SCANU_RESULT_IND` beacon/probe response, then add connect command.

**Cautions**
- `wifi_test_enable()` reinitializes SDIO regs every command. So far safe for MM commands, but persistent netdev/data path should avoid unnecessary reinit later.
- If a message times out, late CFM may pollute next command. Current helper drains late packet after timeout only. For scan, async indications may arrive before expected CFM or after; existing `wifi_test_send_msg` rejects unexpected msg id. Might need a more flexible helper that can skip/drain async indications until expected CFM.
- Current `wifi_test_msg_recv` supports max 512 bytes. Scan result indications may exceed 512 or report block count >1; current bottom CMD53 helper restricts length <=512. For early scan, `SCANU_START_CFM_ADDTIONAL` should be small; `SCANU_RESULT_IND` may be 512 or more. If `rx length unsupported`, need expand SDMC helper to support multi-block CMD53 or just print first unsupported length first.
- `rxpoll` all no packet before scan is expected.

# wifi_test

`wifi_test probe` powers the onboard SDIO Wi-Fi module and sends SDIO CMD5 on
SDMC0. It is a bus-level checkpoint only; it does not load Wi-Fi firmware or
register `wlan0`.

Useful checkpoints:

- `wifi_test cccr` dumps CCCR and FBR registers.
- `wifi_test cis` dumps the common and function CIS tuples.
- `wifi_test enable` sets function 1 block size to 512 bytes, enables
  function 1, and applies the minimum AIC8800D80 SDIO register writes used by
  the Luban driver.
- `wifi_test cmd53` runs the same initialization and then verifies CMD53
  block-mode FIFO write on function 1.
- `wifi_test msg` sends a minimal AIC8800D80 `DBG_MEM_READ_REQ` message and
  dumps the confirmation packet using the D80 E2A message layout.
- `wifi_test memtest` writes 16 bytes to `0x00120000` with
  `DBG_MEM_BLOCK_WRITE_REQ`, then reads the first word back with
  `DBG_MEM_READ_REQ`. This is the firmware-upload preflight check.
- `wifi_test fwload` uploads `fmacfw_8800d80_u02` to `0x00120000` in
  480-byte message chunks, verifies the first word, and sends
  `DBG_START_APP_REQ`.
- `wifi_test fwstate` reads `0x40500004` and prints the firmware-up bit used by
  the Luban driver.
- `wifi_test version` sends `MM_VERSION_REQ` after firmware start and prints
  the `MM_VERSION_CFM` fields.
- `wifi_test initcmd` sends `MM_RESET_REQ` after firmware start, then repeats
  `MM_VERSION_REQ`.
- `wifi_test stackstart` sends `MM_SET_STACK_START_REQ` using the D80 normal
  mode parameters from the Luban driver.
- `wifi_test rfcalib` sends D80 `MM_SET_RF_CALIB_REQ` with the Luban default
  calibration parameters and prints the returned gain-table addresses.
- `wifi_test rfchain` sends stack start, waits briefly, then sends RF
  calibration. This isolates post-stack timing from the full bringup chain.
- `wifi_test mebasic` sends minimal `ME_CONFIG_REQ` and `ME_CHAN_CONFIG_REQ`
  messages.
- `wifi_test macstart` sends a minimal `MM_START_REQ` message.
- `wifi_test bringup` runs the current post-firmware checkpoint chain:
  reset, version, stack start, RF calibration, ME config, channel config, and
  MAC start.
- `wifi_test netreg` registers the current minimal AIC fullmac network-device
  skeleton as `wlan0`. At this checkpoint RX/TX are still stubbed, so this is
  for verifying NuttX network registration with `ifconfig wlan0`.
- `wifi_test rxpoll [count]` polls the D80 SDIO RX FIFO and prints the raw
  host packet type/header. Use it after bringup or later scan/connect
  checkpoints to see firmware async events and data packets.

function(nuttx_add_application)

  # parse arguments into variables

    FUNC

    ONE_VALUE

    INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES
    SRCS
    DEPENDS
    DEFINITIONS
    OPTIONS
    NO_MAIN_ALIAS
    ARGN
    ${ARGN})

  if(NOT NAME)
    return()
  endif()

  # check if SRCS exist
  if(SRCS)
    file(GLOB SRCS_EXIST ${SRCS})
  endif()

  # Initialize TARGET variable
  set(TARGET "")

       OR "${DYNLIB}" STREQUAL "y")

text: 我查到一个关键配置：`CONFIG_FS_BINFS` 没开，所以这些 builtin app 不会以 `/bin/wifi_test` 文件形式出现，`ls /bin` 或文件系统里找不到是正常的。`CONFIG_NSH_BUILTIN_APPS=y` 已开，`wifi_test` 应该是 NSH builtin 命令，直接在 `nsh>` 输入 `wifi_test probe` 才能跑。

我仔细看了构建，结论是：本地这次生成的镜像里 **有 `wifi_test`**。

证据：

- `cmake_out/demo88-nor_nsh/nuttx` 里有 `wifi_test`、`scanpoll`、`MM_ADD_IF`、`SCANU_START`
- `nuttx/nuttx.elf` 里也有
- `vendor/artinchip/pack/prebuilt/d13x.elf` 里也有
- 最终镜像 `d13x_demo88-nor_v1.0.0.img` 用 `strings` 也能查到 `wifi_test`
- builtin 表里有：
  ```c
  { "wifi_test", SCHED_PRIORITY_DEFAULT, 3072, wifi_test_main },
  ```

关键点是：这个工程没开 `CONFIG_FS_BINFS`，所以 `wifi_test` **不会出现在 `/bin` 或文件系统里**。它是 NSH builtin app，要直接敲：

```sh
wifi_test
wifi_test probe
```

如果你是在板子上 `ls /bin` 找不到，那是正常的。

如果直接敲 `wifi_test` 还是 `not found`，那基本就是烧录/启动的不是这份镜像。请确认烧的是这个 raw image：

```sh
/home/luisleee/Desktop/vela/vendor/artinchip/pack/prebuilt/d13x_demo88-nor_v1.0.0.img
```

不要用旧的 `.simg` 或别的输出；这里 `img2simg` 因缺 `libselinux.so.1` 失败，只有 raw `.img` 是这次更新过的。

从你贴的包看，`0x004f` 后面紧跟着 `0x1001`，而 `0x1001` 的 param 里最后是 `result_cnt=1/3/0` 这类信息。先把工具改到能把同一个 512 字节 RX buffer 里的多条 message 都解出来，这样下一步才能看结果 IND 是否被压在同一个读里。
我会顺手把 `scan` 的确认解析也改稳一点：目前它在等 `0x1009` 时，可能同一个 RX 里先有 `0x1009`、后面还有 `0x1004/0x1001`，旧代码只拿第一条。改法是集中做一个 message 迭代器，`rxpoll` 和 `send_msg` 都复用它。

`SM_CONNECT_CFM status=0` 已经成功，说明 `SM_CONNECT_REQ` 结构基本对了。失败点是后续关联完成 IND 包来了，但 RX 长度是 `status=0x04 -> 2048 bytes`，我们现在 RX buffer 只支持 512，所以需要把 RX 支持扩到多块 CMD53。
我先改成 TX 仍按当前逻辑，RX buffer 放大到 4096，`rxpoll` 和 `send_msg` 都能读 2048/4096。然后重新构建打包，你再跑 `joinportal` 就能看到 `SM_CONNECT_IND` 里的 status。

text: `0x0044 = MM_CONNECTION_LOSS_IND` 基本确认了，所以连接请求被接受后很快掉线。下一步我对照 `rwnx_send_sm_connect_req()`，看看我们的 `SM_CONNECT_REQ` 字段有没有偏移/字节序/默认值不一致。
我看到一个高概率问题：`ctrl_port_ethertype` 注释写的是网络字节序，而我们现在用 little-endian 写 `0x888e`，实际发出去是 `8e 88`。开放网络虽然理论上不走 EAPOL，但字段不对可能影响状态机；先改成网络序字节 `88 8e`，同时加最小的 `MM_CONNECTION_LOSS_IND` 名字打印。
我刚重新数了一下枚举，之前差了一位：`0x0044` 更像 `MM_CHANNEL_SWITCH_IND`，`0x004f` 是 `MM_CHANNEL_SURVEY_IND`。这反而说明不是立刻失败，而是连接流程/信道状态在继续；我会只加这两个名字和 `ctrl_port` 字节序修正。

# wifi_test

`wifi_test probe` powers the onboard SDIO Wi-Fi module and sends SDIO CMD5 on
SDMC0. It is a bus-level checkpoint only; it does not load Wi-Fi firmware or
register `wlan0`.

Useful checkpoints:

- `wifi_test cccr` dumps CCCR and FBR registers.
- `wifi_test cis` dumps the common and function CIS tuples.
- `wifi_test enable` sets function 1 block size to 512 bytes, enables
  function 1, and applies the minimum AIC8800D80 SDIO register writes used by
  the Luban driver.
- `wifi_test cmd53` runs the same initialization and then verifies CMD53
  block-mode FIFO write on function 1.
- `wifi_test msg` sends a minimal AIC8800D80 `DBG_MEM_READ_REQ` message and
  dumps the confirmation packet using the D80 E2A message layout.
- `wifi_test memtest` writes 16 bytes to `0x00120000` with
  `DBG_MEM_BLOCK_WRITE_REQ`, then reads the first word back with
  `DBG_MEM_READ_REQ`. This is the firmware-upload preflight check.
- `wifi_test fwload` uploads `fmacfw_8800d80_u02` to `0x00120000` in
  480-byte message chunks, verifies the first word, and sends
  `DBG_START_APP_REQ`.
- `wifi_test fwstate` reads `0x40500004` and prints the firmware-up bit used by
  the Luban driver.
- `wifi_test version` sends `MM_VERSION_REQ` after firmware start and prints
  the `MM_VERSION_CFM` fields.
- `wifi_test initcmd` sends `MM_RESET_REQ` after firmware start, then repeats
  `MM_VERSION_REQ`.
- `wifi_test stackstart` sends `MM_SET_STACK_START_REQ` using the D80 normal
  mode parameters from the Luban driver.
- `wifi_test rfcalib` sends D80 `MM_SET_RF_CALIB_REQ` with the Luban default
  calibration parameters and prints the returned gain-table addresses.
- `wifi_test rfchain` sends stack start, waits briefly, then sends RF
  calibration. This isolates post-stack timing from the full bringup chain.
- `wifi_test mebasic` sends minimal `ME_CONFIG_REQ` and `ME_CHAN_CONFIG_REQ`
  messages.
- `wifi_test macstart` sends a minimal `MM_START_REQ` message.
- `wifi_test bringup` runs the current post-firmware checkpoint chain:
  reset, version, stack start, RF calibration, ME config, channel config, and
  MAC start.
- `wifi_test addif` sends `MM_ADD_IF_REQ` to create one STA VIF using the
  test MAC address.
- `wifi_test scan [1|6|11]` sends a one-channel wildcard `SCANU_START_REQ`
  using existing VIF 0. The optional argument selects channel 1, 6, or 11; a
  raw frequency in MHz is also accepted.
- `wifi_test scanpoll [1|6|11]` creates one STA VIF, starts a one-channel
  wildcard scan, then polls the RX FIFO for scan confirmations and
  `SCANU_RESULT_IND` events.
- `wifi_test netreg` registers the current minimal AIC fullmac network-device
  skeleton as `wlan0`. At this checkpoint RX/TX are still stubbed, so this is
  for verifying NuttX network registration with `ifconfig wlan0`.
- `wifi_test rxpoll [count]` polls the D80 SDIO RX FIFO and prints the raw
  host packet type/header. Use it after bringup or later scan/connect
  checkpoints to see firmware async events and data packets.

- [wifi_test_main.c](/home/luisleee/Desktop/vela/contest2026_094_andy/app/wifi_test/wifi_test_main.c:106) 按 AIC 自然对齐结构解析 `SM_CONNECT_IND`：

  - `aid` 在 offset 820
  - `center_freq` 在 offset 824
- 现在会打印 `assoc_ie req_len/rsp_len`，以及正确的 `aid/band/center_freq/width/center_freq1/center_freq2`。

```text
sm_connect_ind status=0 ...
assoc_ie req_len=... rsp_len=...
aid=... band=... center_freq=... width=...
```

如果 `center_freq` 变成 `2412/2437/2462` 这种合理值，就可以继续接 `DATA_FW2SOC` 到 `wlan0` 数据面了。
这次确认了：固件层已经真正关联成功，`vif=1/ap_idx=1/aid=1/freq=2462` 都合理。下一步我开始接数据面，先读 AIC 原驱动的 RX/TX 描述符格式，再把 `DATA_FW2SOC` 做成可验证的最小收包路径。
AIC 原驱动这条线索有用：固件给主机的数据块不是纯 802.3，而是 `fhost_rx_buf_tag` 风格，里面有 RX info，再跟 802.11 payload。我要继续定位这个结构开头和 payload 偏移，先做一个 `rxdata` 调试解析命令/打印，确认我们收到的数据帧到底是什么格式。
`rx_info` 结构很可能是 64 字节级别，`vect.frmlen` 在结构第一个字段里。为了不盲接网络栈，我会先在 `DATA_FW2SOC` 分支打印 RX info 和尝试识别 802.11 header/LLC SNAP；这一步能告诉我们是否已经能取出 ARP/DHCP/EAPOL 这类帧。

/* The Ethernet header -- 14 bytes. The first two fields are type 'struct
 * ether_addr but are represented as a simple byte array here because
 * some compilers refuse to pack 6 byte structures.
 */

struct eth_hdr_s
{
  uint8_t  dest[6]; /* Ethernet destination address (6 bytes) */
  uint8_t  src[6];  /* Ethernet source address (6 bytes) */
  uint16_t type;    /* Type code (2 bytes) */
};

/* IEEE 802.1Q adds a 32-bit field between the source MAC address and the
 * type fields of the original Ethernet header.  Two bytes are used for the
 * tag protocol identifier (TPID), the other two bytes for tag control
 * information  TCI).  The TCI field is further divided into PCP, DEI, and
 * VID.
 */

struct eth_8021qhdr_s
{
  uint8_t  dest[6]; /* Ethernet destination address (6 bytes) */

/****************************************************************************

/* The Ethernet header -- 14 bytes. The first two fields are type 'struct
 * ether_addr but are represented as a simple byte array here because
 * some compilers refuse to pack 6 byte structures.
 */

struct eth_hdr_s
{
  uint8_t  dest[6]; /* Ethernet destination address (6 bytes) */
  uint8_t  src[6];  /* Ethernet source address (6 bytes) */
  uint16_t type;    /* Type code (2 bytes) */
};

/* IEEE 802.1Q adds a 32-bit field between the source MAC address and the
 * type fields of the original Ethernet header.  Two bytes are used for the
 * tag protocol identifier (TPID), the other two bytes for tag control
 * information  TCI).  The TCI field is further divided into PCP, DEI, and
 * VID.
 */

struct eth_8021qhdr_s
{
  uint8_t  dest[6]; /* Ethernet destination address (6 bytes) */
  uint8_t  src[6];  /* Ethernet source address (6 bytes) */
  uint16_t tpid;    /* TCI: Tag protocol identifier (2 bytes) */
  uint16_t tci;     /* TCI: Tag control information: PCP, DEI, VID (2 bytes) */
  uint16_t type;    /* Type code (2 bytes) */
};

可以删/缩，但要看你想腾哪种空间：

1. **对 SRAM 没帮助**
   `env/env_r/rodata` 都是 SPI NOR Flash 分区。删它们不会减少 `.bss/.stack/heap`，也不会解决运行时 `malloc failed` 或 WAPI 链接 SRAM 溢出。

2. **能腾 Flash**
   当前 NOR 16MB 分区：
   ```text
   512k spl, 128k env, 128k env_r, 2m os, 12m rodata, 1m data
   ```
   `rodata` 最大，删/缩它能腾最多 Flash。实际生成的 `rodata.fatfs` 现在约 2.4MB，但分区给了 12MB，所以可以考虑把 `rodata` 从 12MB 缩到比如 3MB 或 4MB，把空间让给 `os` 或 `data`。

3. **不建议先删 env/env_r**
   它们只有 256KB，总收益小，而且 `env.txt` 里有：
   ```text
   osAB_next/osAB_now
   rodata_partname=blk_rodata
   data_partname=blk_data
   bootcount/bootlimit
   ```
   删了可能影响 bootloader 环境、AB 状态或分区名解析。收益不值得冒这个风险。

4. **rodata 可以考虑缩，不建议直接删**
   `rodata` 是可选分区，但板级代码/环境里有 `/rodata`、`blk_rodata` 这类约定。直接删可能导致挂载失败或某些资源访问失败。更稳的是缩小：
   ```text
   512k(spl),128k(env),128k(env_r),3m(os),10m(rodata),2m(data)
   ```
   或 Wi-Fi 调试版：
   ```text
   512k(spl),128k(env),128k(env_r),4m(os),8m(rodata),3m(data)
   ```

结论：如果目标是给 WAPI/代码镜像留 Flash，缩 `rodata`、增 `os` 可以；如果目标是解决 SRAM/malloc，删这些分区没用，还是要关模块、减静态 buffer、把 heap/大 buffer 放 PSRAM。

测试命令先记一下，等我改完烧新镜像后按这个跑：`fwload`、`bringup`、`joinportal`、`ifconfig wlan0 up`、`renew wlan0`、然后 `wifi_test rxfeed 30`，最后 `ifconfig`。`rxfeed` 是我准备新增的喂包命令。
一个关键点：`DATA_FW2SOC` 的 16-bit 长度不是整块 SDIO 子消息长度，而更像 802.11 MPDU 长度；前面还有固件 RX metadata。之前 dump 把 `sdio_len` 当总长度，所以会误判、截断。我要先把这个解析修正掉，否则喂栈会喂错包。

 * the Ethernet type field in untagged frames and is thus used to

#define ETH_8021Q_HDRLEN 18     /* Header size: 2*6 + 4 + 2 */

/****************************************************************************
 * Public Types
 ****************************************************************************/

/* The Ethernet header -- 14 bytes. The first two fields are type 'struct
 * ether_addr but are represented as a simple byte array here because
 * some compilers refuse to pack 6 byte structures.
 */

struct eth_hdr_s
{
  uint8_t  dest[6]; /* Ethernet destination address (6 bytes) */
  uint8_t  src[6];  /* Ethernet source address (6 bytes) */
  uint16_t type;    /* Type code (2 bytes) */
};

/* IEEE 802.1Q adds a 32-bit field between the source MAC address and the
 * type fields of the original Ethernet header.  Two bytes are used for the
 * tag protocol identifier (TPID), the other two bytes for tag control
 * information  TCI).  The TCI field is further divided into PCP, DEI, and
 * VID.
 */

struct eth_8021qhdr_s
{
  uint8_t  dest[6]; /* Ethernet destination address (6 bytes) */
  uint8_t  src[6];  /* Ethernet source address (6 bytes) */
  uint16_t tpid;    /* TCI: Tag protocol identifier (2 bytes) */
  uint16_t tci;     /* TCI: Tag control information: PCP, DEI, VID (2 bytes) */
  uint16_t type;    /* Type code (2 bytes) */

我已经改好并打包了新镜像：

```text
/home/luisleee/Desktop/vela/vendor/artinchip/pack/prebuilt/d13x_demo88-nor_v1.0.0.img

这版新增/修复了：

- `DATA_FW2SOC` 按 `rx_info + 802.11 MPDU` 正确解析，不再把 payload 中间误判成子消息。
- 802.11 data + LLC/SNAP 转成 Ethernet frame。
- 喂给 NuttX `arp_input()` / `ipv4_input()`。
- 新增 `wifi_test rxfeed [count]`，用于手动收包并送协议栈。
- `rxpoll` 也会边 dump 边喂栈。

你烧新镜像后这样测：

```sh
help
wifi_test fwload
wifi_test bringup
wifi_test joinportal
ifconfig wlan0 up
renew wlan0
wifi_test rxfeed 50
ifconfig
```

如果 `renew wlan0` 会阻塞等包，就开另一个时机：先执行 `renew wlan0`，如果超时失败，再马上跑：

```sh
wifi_test rxfeed 100
renew wlan0
wifi_test rxfeed 100
ifconfig
```

重点看日志里有没有：

```text
wifi_test: rx feed len=... eth=ARP
wifi_test: rx feed len=... eth=IPv4
wifi_test: tx data[...] ... eth=0x0800
```

如果最后还是没 IP，把 `renew wlan0` 和 `wifi_test rxfeed 100` 的完整输出贴我，下一步看 DHCP DISCOVER/OFFER 是 TX 没出去、RX 没喂到 socket，还是 AP 没回。

**Key Diagnosis From Latest Log**
- `ifup=no` is critical. `ifconfig wlan0 up` did not call `wifi_test_net_ifup()`. It also assigned garbage-like broadcast address `255.255.255.255`.
- Need try target command `ifup wlan0` instead of `ifconfig wlan0 up`, but code should also set `priv->ifup=true` after successful connect as a fallback.
- Bigger architectural issue: `renew wlan0` blocks waiting for DHCP packets, but current RX feeding only occurs when user manually runs `wifi_test rxfeed`. If `renew` is blocking, no one is polling SDIO RX, so DHCP OFFER cannot reach socket. Running `rxfeed` after `renew` returns is too late.
- Need add automatic/background RX polling thread started after connect. This should continuously call `wifi_test_msg_recv(..., poll_retries=1)` and `wifi_test_feed_rx_packet()` while connected. That should allow `renew wlan0` to receive DHCP OFFER while it is blocked.

**Recommended Next Steps**
1. Modify `wifi_test_main.c`:

   - Add fields to `struct wifi_test_netdev_s`:

     bool rx_thread_started;
     bool rx_thread_stop;

Simpler: background uses same static buffer and advise not to run `rxfeed` once auto thread exists, or add mutex.

     - On success call `wifi_test_feed_rx_packet(rx, rx_len, false)`.

     - On other errors, print limited-rate error and sleep.
   - Start thread after successful `SM_CONNECT_IND` or before returning from `wifi_test_connect_open()`.
   - Set `g_wifi_test_netdev.ifup = true` after successful connect, and possibly call `netdev_carrier_on()`.
   - Stop thread in `wifi_test_net_ifdown()`.
2. Rebuild/package.
3. Ask user to test:
   ```sh
   wifi_test joinportal
   ifup wlan0        # try this instead of ifconfig wlan0 up
   renew wlan0
   ifconfig
   ```
   With auto RX thread, `wifi_test rxfeed` should no longer be needed.
4. If DHCP still fails, inspect logs:
   - Look for `wifi_test: tx data[...] eth=0x0800` during `renew` to confirm DHCP DISCOVER sent.
   - Look for auto RX logs for `ARP/IPv4`.
   - If no DHCP OFFER, TX path may be malformed. Need decode `DATA_SOC2FW` hostdesc against `tx_swdesc.h`.

**Important Existing Functions**
- `wifi_test_send_eth_frame()` at around line ~1222 handles DATA_SOC2FW TX.
- `wifi_test_msg_recv()` around line ~1095 polls SDIO RX.
- `wifi_test_feed_rx_packet()` added around RX dump logic.
- `wifi_test_feed_rx_msg()` added before `wifi_test_dump_data_frame()`.
- `wifi_test_connect_open()` around line ~2600: after `wifi_test_wait_connect_ind()` it currently calls `netdev_carrier_on()` and prints carrier on. Best place to start RX thread and set `ifup=true`.
- `wifi_test_net_ifup()`/`ifdown()` around early netdev functions. Current target shows `ifup` callback not triggered by `ifconfig wlan0 up`.

**Potential Race / Design Caution**
- `g_wifi_test_rxbuf` is a global static buffer; current manual commands (`rxfeed`, `rxpoll`, message send) also use it. A background RX thread can race with foreground `wifi_test` commands. For first debug build:
  - Start auto RX thread only after connect.
  - Avoid running `rxfeed/rxpoll` concurrently with `renew`.
  - Better robust fix: add `pthread_mutex_t g_wifi_test_sdio_lock` around all SDIO CMD52/CMD53 access or at least around `wifi_test_msg_recv` and TX. This is more invasive but likely needed if background RX runs while user calls `wifi_test` commands.
- DHCP `renew` calls `d_txavail`, which sends via `wifi_test_send_eth_frame()`. If background RX also polls SDIO status at same time, lock may be necessary.

**User Preference**
- Chinese, concise, direct.
- User wants to keep moving and tests quickly.
- Avoid breaking boot and avoid broad refactors.

你的思路是对的：最终应该走 `wlan0` 标准接口，让 `wapi` / `ifup` / `renew` 这些现成命令驱动它，而不是长期靠 `wifi_test joinportal/rxfeed` 这种手工命令。

但这里有个关键点：`wapi` 不是独立 Wi-Fi 驱动，它只是用户态命令。它能不能工作，取决于 `wlan0` 的驱动有没有实现无线 ioctl。现在我们的 `wifi_test` 只是把 AIC8800 低层消息拼出来了，能手动发 `SM_CONNECT_REQ`，也能注册 `wlan0`，但还没把这些能力接到 `wlan0.d_ioctl` 上。所以现在直接用 `wapi`，大概率只能看到命令存在，实际设置 SSID/扫描/连接会返回不支持或无效果。

我认为正确路径应该分两层：

1. **先把 `wlan0` 做成一个真的可用 netdev**
   - `ifup wlan0` 能正确触发 `d_ifup`
   - `renew wlan0` 能通过 `d_txavail` 发 DHCP
   - 驱动后台自动收 SDIO RX，把 DHCP OFFER 喂给协议栈
   - 这一步不依赖 `wapi`，但 DHCP 必须靠它

2. **再实现 `d_ioctl`，让 `wapi` 调用现有连接逻辑**
   - `wapi scan wlan0` -> 发 `SCANU_START_REQ`
   - `wapi essid wlan0 BUPT-portal` / 类似设置 -> 保存 SSID
   - `wapi ap wlan0 <bssid>` / `wapi freq ...` -> 保存 BSSID/freq
   - `wapi commit wlan0` 或 `ifup wlan0` -> 发 `MM_ADD_IF_REQ` + `SM_CONNECT_REQ`
   - open AP 先支持；WPA/WAPI 加密后面再看，因为那还需要认证/密钥路径，不只是命令问题

所以我刚才想补后台 RX，不是想继续走野路子，而是因为即使切到 `wapi`，**DHCP 仍然必须有自动 RX pump**。否则 `renew wlan0` 阻塞时没人从 SDIO 收包，OFFER 永远进不了 socket。

我建议调整实现顺序：

- 下一步先不再扩 `joinportal` 功能。
- 把 `wifi_test` 里的低层函数整理成 `wlan0` 驱动后端。
- 先实现最小 `d_ioctl`，支持 open SSID 连接。
- 保留 `wifi_test joinportal` 作为调试入口，但正式测试改成：

```

**Handoff Summary**

**Repo / Workspace**
- Main repo: `/home/luisleee/Desktop/vela`
- Main file: `/home/luisleee/Desktop/vela/contest2026_094_andy/app/wifi_test/wifi_test_main.c`
- Board defconfig: `/home/luisleee/Desktop/vela/contest2026_094_andy/board/d13x/demo88-nor/configs/nsh/defconfig`
- Image output: `/home/luisleee/Desktop/vela/vendor/artinchip/pack/prebuilt/d13x_demo88-nor_v1.0.0.img`
- User tests on target via NSH and pastes logs. Respond in Chinese, concise/direct.

**User Direction / Preferences**
- Goal: proper `wlan0 + wapi + renew` path, not manual `rxfeed`.
- Current target: open AP `BUPT-portal`, DHCP, then portal access.
- Keep LVGL if possible; test apps can be disabled for SRAM. User said `lvgl_test` can be disabled.
- User interrupted because assistant incorrectly assumed ping target was self. `10.3.8.216` is portal auth server.

**Config / Build State**
- Enabled:
  - `CONFIG_SYSTEM_DHCPC_RENEW=y`
  - `CONFIG_NETDEV_WIRELESS_IOCTL=y`
  - `CONFIG_WIRELESS_WAPI=y`
  - `CONFIG_WIRELESS_WAPI_CMDTOOL=y`
  - `CONFIG_MM_REGIONS=2`
  - `CONFIG_NET_ARP=y`
  - `CONFIG_NETUTILS_DHCPC=y`
- Build/pack commands:
  ```sh
  cd /home/luisleee/Desktop/vela
  ./build.sh contest2026_094_andy/board/d13x/demo88-nor/configs/nsh --cmake -j8
  cp -f cmake_out/demo88-nor_nsh/nuttx nuttx/nuttx.elf
  cp -f cmake_out/demo88-nor_nsh/nuttx.manifest nuttx/nuttx.manifest
  cd vendor/artinchip/pack && ./pack.sh demo88-nor d13x
  ```
- `img2simg: libselinux.so.1` during pack is non-fatal; raw `.img` is generated.
- Current build passes.

**Major Implemented Progress**
- `wifi_test_main.c` has minimal WAPI ioctl support for `wlan0`:
  - `SIOCSIWMODE/SIOCGIWMODE`
  - `SIOCSIWFREQ/SIOCGIWFREQ`
  - `SIOCSIWAP/SIOCGIWAP`
  - `SIOCSIWESSID/SIOCGIWESSID`
  - stub scan/range/encode
- `wapi essid wlan0 BUPT-portal 1` triggers `wifi_test_connect_open()`.
- `wlan0` registers and carrier turns on after `SM_CONNECT_IND`.
- Background RX thread starts after connect.
- SDIO access guarded by `g_wifi_test_sdio_lock`.
- `renew wlan0` now works and obtains an IP.
- Key TX fix that made DHCP work:
  - For data TX, hostdesc contains DA/SA/ethertype.
  - Payload after hostdesc must exclude Ethernet header.
  - `hostdesc.packet_len = eth_len - 14`.
  - hostdesc ethertype must be copied in network byte order (`memcpy(&tx[24], &frame[12], 2)`), not `put_le16`.
  - Payload begins at `frame + 14`.
- Current TX hexdump should show `packet_len=0x0125` and hostdesc followed by `45 00 ...`, not repeated `ff ff ... 08 00`.

**Latest User Runtime**
- User confirmed: “这次拿到ip了”.
- Then tried:
  ```text
  nsh> ping 10.3.8.216
  PING 10.3.8.216 56 bytes of data
  wifi_test: wlan0 txavail count=8 ifup=yes connected=yes
  wifi_test: tx data[8] eth_len=42 payload=28 padded=512 flow=0x7f vif=1 sta=1 eth=0x0806
  ERROR: sendto failed at seqno 0: 101
  ...
  10 packets transmitted, 0 received, 100% packet loss
  ```
- User clarified `10.3.8.216` is the portal auth address, not local IP.
- Important: ping TX log shows `vif=1 sta=1`, suggesting test was not from a clean boot or repeated `wapi essid` created a second VIF. Repeated connect currently calls `wifi_test_add_if()` every time.

**Current Diagnosis**
- DHCP works, so TX format is now mostly correct.
- Ping fails with errno `101` (`ENETUNREACH` in NuttX path likely from ARP resolution). `ping` emitted ARP TX (`eth=0x0806`) but likely did not receive/feed ARP reply.
- Need determine if:
  - route/default gateway/netmask from DHCP is valid (`ifconfig` should show `DRaddr` and mask),
  - RX thread is failing to feed ARP/IP frames,
  - repeated VIF state (`vif=1 sta=1`) is causing instability,
  - portal server outside subnet means ARP target should be gateway, so `DRaddr` must be nonzero.
- In `nuttx/net/arp/arp_send.c`, for off-subnet targets it ARPs `dev->d_draddr`; if `d_draddr == INADDR_ANY`, returns `-EHOSTUNREACH`. If ARP wait times out, ping may fail.

**Important Code References**
- AIC reference driver:
  - `/home/luisleee/Desktop/vela/luban-lite/bsp/peripheral/wireless/aic8800`
- TX hostdesc:
  - `fdrv/macif/tx_swdesc.h`
  - `struct hostdesc` layout; first 28 bytes:
    ```c
    u16 packet_len;
    u16 flags_ext;
    u32 hostid;
    mac eth_dest_addr;
    mac eth_src_addr;
    u16 ethertype;
    u8 ac;
    u8 tid;
    u8 vif_idx;
    u8 staid;
    u16 flags;
    ```
- Reference TX behavior found by disassembling `libwlan_aic8800_e907f.a`:
  - `fhost_tx_req` for `TCPIP_PKTTYPE_ETHER` copies DA/SA/ethertype from Ethernet header, subtracts 14 from length, advances payload pointer by 14, sets packet_len to payload length.
- RX reference:
  - `fdrv/macif/rwnx_utils.c`, `rwnx_rxdataind_aicwf`
  - `fhost_rx_buf_tag` has `struct rx_info info` then payload.
  - `struct rx_info` in `fdrv/macif/rwnx_rx.h`; size appears 60 bytes (rx_vector 36 + phy 8 + flags 4 + pattern 4 + reserved[2] 4 = 56? Check actual compiler alignment; current code uses `WIFI_TEST_RX_DESC_LEN 56`, but logs suggested actual 802.11 frame starts at offset `0x3c`/60 in some packets).
- Previous RX log after old version:
  ```text
  submsg[0] off=0 sdio_len=1400 host_type=0x00(DATA_FW2SOC)
    data fw2soc mpdu_len=1400 desc_len=56 flags=0x00000000
    802.11 off=4 fctl=0x0000 ...   (mis-detected)
  raw:
  0000: 78 05 00 00 ...
  0030: 42 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 f0 00 00 00
  0040: ff ff ff ff ff ff b0 b8 ...
  ```
  Looks like actual payload may begin at offset `0x3c` from data area (SDIO header excluded), not 56. Current code may still be wrong for RX feed.

**Current Code Hotspots**
- `wifi_test_rx_data_frame()` currently assumes fixed `WIFI_TEST_RX_DESC_LEN` and starts 802.11 frame at `data + WIFI_TEST_RX_DESC_LEN`.
- `wifi_test_dump_data_frame()` uses `wifi_test_find_80211_frame()` fallback only for dumps, not feed.
- `wifi_test_connect_open()` always does `wifi_test_add_if(&vif_idx)` even if already connected; repeated WAPI calls can allocate VIF 1, etc.
- `wifi_test_netreg()` early returns if registered, so state may carry over.

**Recommended Next Steps**
1. Ask user to paste `ifconfig` after successful `renew`:
   - Need `wlan0 inet addr`, `DRaddr`, `Mask`.
   - Confirm if `DRaddr` is sane and if `10.3.8.216` should route through gateway.
2. Fix repeated VIF:
   - In `wifi_test_connect_open()`, if `g_wifi_test_netdev.connected` and SSID same, avoid `MM_ADD_IF_REQ` or at least force clean disconnect/reset before reconnect.
   - For testing, tell user to use cold boot/`fwload+bringup+netreg` once.
3. Fix RX feed:
   - Parse RX info struct properly. Likely data layout for DATA_FW2SOC is:
     - SDIO header 4 bytes,
     - `struct rx_info` (probably 60 bytes),
     - 802.11 payload of `sdio_len` or `rx_info.vect.frmlen`.
   - Use `rx_info.vect.frmlen` (`data[0..1]`) for MPDU length and find payload offset robustly:
     - try offsets around 56 and 60; require valid data frame + LLC SNAP.
     - For feeding, don’t blindly require fixed offset.
   - Add verbose logs for fed ARP/IP:
     - `wifi_test: rx feed len=... eth=ARP/IPv4 src=... dst=...`
     - If ARP reply arrives but not fed, dump reason.
4. Consider lowering debug noise after stable:
   - TX hexdump currently prints first 3 TX packets.
   - Keep only short logs once portal/ping works.
5. Build and pack after changes with commands above.

**Potential Test Commands for User**
After next image:
```sh
wifi_test fwload
wifi_test bringup
wifi_test netreg
ifup wlan0
wapi mode wlan0 2
wapi essid wlan0 BUPT-portal 1
renew wlan0
ifconfig
ping 10.3.8.216
```
Ask for:
- `ifconfig` after renew
- `ping` logs including ARP TX and any `rx thread ... fed=...`
- If ping fails, run `wifi_test rxpoll 10` and paste first packet dump.

text: 你说得对，我刚才把目标地址理解错了。对现在状态的判断改成：DHCP 成功说明 DHCP Discover/Offer/Request/Ack 至少有一轮能通；ping portal 失败要重点查 ARP reply 或后续 IPv4 RX 是否被正确转换/上送，以及 `vif/sta` 状态是否因为重复连接漂移。
我先纠正一点实现判断：AIC 的 RX 描述头不是 56 字节，参考 `struct rx_info` 实际是 60 字节。你日志里真正的 802.11 帧也正好从 raw `0x40` 开始，旧代码从 `0x3c` 起读，前面多了 4 个尾字段，所以经常把返回包当成坏帧丢掉。
我会直接改代码并重新打包镜像。改动范围保持在 `wifi_test_main.c`：修正 RX 描述头长度/候选帧长度、增加 ARP/IPv4 上送日志、连接前复用已有 VIF，避免重复 `ADD_IF` 导致 `vif_idx` 漂移。
这里还有一个细节：RX 包里有些不是给 IP 栈的业务帧，而是扫描/管理帧，日志里的 1400 字节更像 firmware 继续吐扫描/邻居信息。我要让上送逻辑只喂真正能转成 Ethernet 的 ARP/IPv4/EAPOL，同时把找不到有效 LLC/SNAP 的原因打出来，避免把扫描帧误喂进协议栈。
另外我会修一个状态机 bug：现在 `SM_CONNECT_IND status!=0` 的情况下函数也会返回成功并拉 carrier，这会让后续 `renew/ping` 在一个假连接上跑。这个会一起改掉。

ifup wlan0
wapi mode wlan0 2
wapi essid wlan0 BUPT-portal 1
renew wlan0
ifconfig

wifi_test: connect fallback on data eth=ARP ... vif=0 sta=1

烧录后测试流程变成：

```sh
ifconfig
ifup wlan0
wapi mode wlan0 2
wapi essid wlan0 BUPT-portal 1
renew wlan0
ifconfig
ping 10.3.8.216
```

预期 `ifconfig` 开机后就能看到 `wlan0`。如果没看到，贴开机日志里 `[D13X] failed to initialize wlan0` 那行。
我为什么连接的时候需要等待非常长的时间，好像发生了fwload

主要有两种“长等待”，不一定真的是在 `fwload`：

1. **开机自动初始化阶段**
   我现在把 `fwload + bringup + netreg` 放进 board bringup 了。因为日志被清掉了，所以你看不到固件上传进度，但开机到 NSH 之前会多等一段。这是正常的。

2. **`wapi essid` 连接阶段**
   这个更可能是你感觉“连接很久”的原因。现在 `wapi essid wlan0 BUPT-portal 1` 只给了 SSID，没有 BSSID/freq，所以驱动发的是：

   ```text
   bssid=ff:ff:ff:ff:ff:ff freq=65535
   ```

   firmware 会自己扫全信道找 AP。你那边 BUPT-portal AP 很多，扫描结果很多，而且我们还在等 `SM_CONNECT_IND` 或 fallback 数据帧，所以可能等十几秒。

怎么判断是不是又在 fwload：

- 开机后先跑：
  ```sh
  ifconfig
  ```
  如果已经能看到 `wlan0`，说明 `fwload/bringup/netreg` 已经完成了，后面 `wapi essid` 的等待不是 fwload，而是扫描/关联等待。

- 如果开机后 `ifconfig` 没有 `wlan0`，那 `wapi essid` 会兜底触发自动初始化，确实会像在连接时做 fwload。

要缩短连接时间，下一步可以改成：`wapi essid` 默认优先用上次成功的 BSSID/freq，或者加一个固定 BUPT-portal 最强 AP 的选择逻辑，避免每次 wildcard 全信道扫描。

你这个日志把问题定位清楚了：开机确实注册了 `wlan0`，但我把 `fw_loaded/brought_up` 状态放在了 `g_wifi_test_netdev` 里，而 `wifi_test_netreg()` 里面会 `memset(priv, 0, ...)`，把这两个状态清掉了。所以 `wapi essid` 里又触发了一次自动 init，前面几分钟大概率就是安静地重新 `fwload`。这是我的状态变量放错位置。现在我改成独立全局状态，并默认普通路径 quiet。
我会做两个具体修正：`fw_loaded/brought_up` 从 netdev 私有结构移到独立全局变量；`g_wifi_test_quiet` 默认设为 true，避免 `wapi` 普通路径继续 dump。然后重编打包。

你判断是对的：从日志里的 `tx msg id=0x0400/0x040d` 看，`wapi essid` 时确实又走了 fwload/DBG 流程。

原因是我把 `fw_loaded/brought_up` 放进了 `g_wifi_test_netdev`，但 `wifi_test_netreg()` 里会 `memset(priv, 0, ...)`，把这两个状态清掉。开机已经初始化过，但连接时又以为没初始化，于是重新静默 `fwload`，所以你等了几分钟。

已修：
- `fw_loaded/brought_up` 改成独立全局变量，不会被 `netreg` 清掉。
- `g_wifi_test_quiet` 默认开启，普通 `wapi essid` 不再 dump 大量 SDIO/msg 包。
- DBG_MEM_READ/DBG_START_APP 也接入 quiet，自动 fwload 时不会再刷 `0x0400/0x040d`。
- `wlan0` 注册时显式清 `ip/draddr/netmask`，避免开机出现假的 `DRaddr=10.0.0.1`。

已重新编译打包：

`/home/luisleee/Desktop/vela/vendor/artinchip/pack/prebuilt/d13x_demo88-nor_v1.0.0.img`

这版烧录后再测：

```sh
ifconfig
ifup wlan0
wapi mode wlan0 2
wapi essid wlan0 BUPT-portal 1
renew wlan0
ifconfig
```

预期：
- 开机 `ifconfig` 有 `wlan0`，但地址/DRaddr/mask 都应是 `0.0.0.0`
- `wapi essid` 不应再出现 `tx msg id=0x0400/0x040d`
- 连接等待时间应明显缩短；剩下的等待就是扫描/关联，不是 fwload。
怎么mount sd卡

在 NSH 里手动挂载：

```sh
nsh> mount -t fatfs /dev/mmcsd1 /sdcard
```

如果 `/sdcard` 目录不存在，先建目录：

```sh
nsh> mkdir /sdcard
nsh> mount -t fatfs /dev/mmcsd1 /sdcard
```

检查是否挂上：

```sh
nsh> df
nsh> ls /sdcard
```

不过我刚加的 `recorder` 会在启动时自动尝试挂载 `/dev/mmcsd1` 到 `/sdcard`，正常情况下不需要你手动 mount。
栈空间需要8192以上
我理解为录音机相关线程都要大于 8192，而不是等于 8192。我会把 recorder 的后台 worker、nxrecorder 录音线程、nxplayer 播放线程都调到 12288，主 `recorder` 命令栈保持 16384。

text: 我现在会做一次小补丁：`tf_test mount` 先创建 `/sdcard`，`tf_test` 栈改成 8192；同时把 SDMC1 初始化日志改准确，不再启动时误报“registered”，并在 `reprobe` 后明确打印有没有 `/dev/mmcsd0`。这能直接区分“命令没进镜像”和“卡没注册”。

你这个日志说明上一版确实误判了：`/data/sdcard` 只是 LittleFS 里的目录，所以 `tf_test info` 看到的是 1MiB `/data` 分区，不是 TF 卡。并且 FAT32 大概率在 MBR/GPT 的第一个分区里，不能直接 mount 整盘 `/dev/mmcsd0`。

我已经改了：
- `tf_test mount` 会先解析 `/dev/mmcsd0` 分区表，注册 `/dev/mmcsd0p1` 等分区，再优先挂分区。
- 如果没有分区表，才退回挂整盘 `/dev/mmcsd0`。
- `tf_test info` 不再把 `/data/sdcard` 的 LittleFS 容量当成 TF 卡容量。
- `recorder` 也改成同样的分区优先挂载逻辑。

已 clean build + pack 成功。新镜像：
`/home/luisleee/Desktop/vela/vendor/artinchip/pack/prebuilt/d13x_demo88-nor_v1.0.0.img`

SHA256：
`1b662f45b1cd0a09fadda6b4df523f3e9caf4dd4c983288690450ab487d2cc61`

烧完后这样测：

```text
nsh> tf_test info
nsh> tf_test mount
nsh> tf_test info
nsh> ls /data/sdcard
nsh> tf_test write
nsh> tf_test check
```

预期 `mount` 成功时会显示挂载的是 `/dev/mmcsd0p1`，`info` 的容量也应该变成你 TF 卡的真实 FAT32 容量，不再是 `1048576 bytes`。
你这写的也没用啊，我原来就是整盘的
对，你说得对。如果你的卡就是整盘 FAT32，那上一版的分区优先逻辑不会解决核心问题，只是修了 `info` 误报 `/data` 容量的问题。真正的错误点是 `mount()` 读 FAT 启动扇区时底层块读返回了 `EIO`，我需要直接看 `/dev/mmcsd0` 的 raw sector 读是否稳定，而不是继续猜分区。

你这个反馈是对的，我上一版把问题方向带偏了。既然你的卡是整盘 FAT32，那现在要修的是 SDMC1 块读可靠性，而不是分区注册；`mount()` 返回 `EIO` 说明 FATFS 读 boot sector 时底层块设备读失败。
我会把上一版的“分区优先”保留为兼容，但现在重点改成验证和修整盘读：给 `tf_test` 加 raw sector 诊断，并检查 SDMC1 传输失败点。这样你下次一跑就能区分“FAT 不识别”和“块读本身 EIO”。

看完了，只读没动文件。结论很直接：现在这次失败最可疑的不是 `tf_test` 的 FAT/mount 逻辑，而是 SDMC1 初始化链路被改了。

距离 `b5c1c30 sdcard` 这个看起来最像“上次 SD 卡成功”的提交，和 SD 卡 raw read 有关的关键变化是：

1. `/dev/mmcsd1` 改成了 `/dev/mmcsd0`
   - `chip/d13x/d13x_sdmc.c`: `D13X_SDMC1_MINOR 1 -> 0`
   - `tf_test`: `TF_TEST_DEVICE "/dev/mmcsd1" -> "/dev/mmcsd0"`
   - 这本身不一定错，但它改变了块设备 minor 和用户侧设备路径。

2. `board_bringup` 不再直接 `d13x_sdmc1_initialize()`，而是调用新增的 `d13x_sdmc1_reprobe()`
   - 老版本：初始化一次，`sdio_mediachange(g_sdmc1, true)`，注册 `/dev/mmcsd1`
   - 新版本：初始化后反复执行：
     ```c
     SDIO_RESET(g_sdmc1);
     sdio_mediachange(g_sdmc1, false);
     delay;
     sdio_mediachange(g_sdmc1, true);
     ```
   - 这很可疑。你现在的现象是 geometry 能拿到、sector 0 读失败，说明 block driver 注册了，但卡/host 数据通路状态可能被这个 reprobe/reset/mediachange 搞坏或没完全稳定。

3. SDMC1 配置从 `4-bit 50MHz` 改成了 `1-bit 25MHz`
   - `defconfig` 当前是：
     ```text
     CONFIG_AIC_SDMC1_BUSWIDTH1=y
     CONFIG_AIC_SDMC1_CLK_FREQ=25000
     ```
   - 上次成功基线是：
     ```text
     CONFIG_AIC_SDMC1_BUSWIDTH4=y
     CONFIG_AIC_SDMC1_CLK_FREQ=50000
     ```
   - 我昨天以为降速更稳，但从现在 raw sector 读 EIO 看，这个改变也必须列为嫌疑。尤其我还改了 vendor `sdmc/Kconfig`，补了 `AIC_SDMC1_BUSWIDTH1`，让它真正生效了。

4. 开启了 SDMC0/Wi-Fi，同时开启了 `CONFIG_AIC_SDMC_IRQ_MODE=y`
   - `b5c1c30` 里 `CONFIG_AIC_USING_SDMC0` 是关的，`CONFIG_AIC_SDMC_IRQ_MODE` 也是关的。
   - 现在为了 Wi-Fi：
     ```text
     CONFIG_AIC_USING_SDMC0=y
     CONFIG_AIC_SDMC0_IS_SDIO=y
     CONFIG_AIC_SDMC_IRQ_MODE=y
     ```
   - 如果 SDMC 驱动的 IRQ/DMA/事件等待路径对 SD 卡读不稳定，这也可能直接解释 `read sector 0 failed: EIO`。

5. `tf_test` 新增的 `sector` 只是把问题暴露出来
   - 它直接调用 block driver `read(inode, sector, 0, 1)`。
   - 你现在它失败，说明不是 FAT32 格式问题，也不是 mountpoint 问题。

我现在按概率排序：
1. `d13x_sdmc1_reprobe()` 里的 `SDIO_RESET + mediachange false/true` 破坏了 SDMC1 已注册后的状态。
2. `CONFIG_AIC_SDMC_IRQ_MODE=y` 开启后，SD 卡 block read 走了不同等待/中断路径。
3. SDMC1 从 `4-bit 50MHz` 改到真正的 `1-bit 25MHz` 后，vendor 驱动/Kconfig 路径不兼容或没按预期配置。
4. minor 从 `/dev/mmcsd1` 改 `/dev/mmcsd0` 本身较低概率，但和 SDMC0 Wi-Fi 同时启用后可能有命名/slot 认知混乱。

最小回退验证应该优先试：保持 Wi-Fi 代码不动，只把 SDMC1 恢复成老的初始化方式和老参数：`D13X_SDMC1_MINOR=1`、`board_bringup` 调 `d13x_sdmc1_initialize()`、`tf_test` 用 `/dev/mmcsd1`、SDMC1 回 `4-bit 50MHz`。这能最快验证“SD 卡基础链路”是不是被后续 Wi-Fi/recorder 改动打断的。

结论：

- `ec0f25e mic` 中的 DMIC 采集主路径与现在一致：DMA 配置、双 `8192` 字节缓冲、启动顺序和 worker 都没变。
- 当前驱动只新增了实时峰值统计以及 Pause/Resume。[d13x_dmic.c](/home/luisleee/Desktop/vela/contest2026_094_andy/chip/d13x/d13x_dmic.c:358)
- 旧 `mic_test` 启动后直接等待指定秒数，不检查首帧，也没有 3 秒启动超时。
- 当前 recorder 要求“峰值序号变化并且 WAV 大于 44 字节”才算启动，否则 3 秒后报 `Microphone start timeout`。[recorder_app_main.c](/home/luisleee/Desktop/vela/contest2026_094_andy/app/recorder_app/recorder_app_main.c:808)
- NxRecorder 的真正初始化发生在异步线程中。DMA 缓冲分配、入队或 `AUDIOIOC_START` 失败时，错误没有传回 recorder UI，于是最终被错误地显示成超时。
- 旧配置没有 Wi-Fi/网络，而且线程栈明显更小；现在 recorder UI、worker、NxRecorder 线程合计占用约 40 KiB 栈，DMIC 还需要连续 16 KiB DMA 内存。因此内存分配失败是当前最可疑的原因。

所以问题并不是历史 DMIC 代码被破坏了，而是新 recorder 的“启动成功检测和错误传播”设计不对。下一步应让 NxRecorder 暴露异步启动结果，并区分 `ENOMEM`、DMA 启动失败和真正超时，不能继续盲等峰值。

# tf_test

This directory is linked to `packages/demos/contest2026_094_tf_test` by the
team manifest.

The command validates the demo88-nor J5 TF-card path through `/dev/mmcsd0`
and a FATFS mount at `/data/sdcard`. It never formats media and only creates
or removes `/data/sdcard/tf_test.bin`.

Insert a FAT/FAT32/exFAT-formatted card before boot, then run:

```text
nsh> tf_test info
nsh> tf_test mount
nsh> tf_test info
nsh> ls /data/sdcard
nsh> tf_test write
nsh> tf_test check
nsh> reboot
nsh> tf_test mount
nsh> tf_test check
nsh> tf_test clear
nsh> tf_test umount
```

Card removal and reinsertion are deferred until card-detect hotplug support is
added. Unmount before removing the card.

Before mounting, `info` confirms that `/dev/mmcsd0` is a block device. After
mounting, it also reports FATFS capacity and available space. NuttX block
device nodes do not support application-level `open()`/`BIOC_GEOMETRY`; the
filesystem and MMC/SD core use the internal block-driver interface instead.
# Recorder

Run `recorder` from NSH. The app mounts `/dev/mmcsd0` at `/data/sdcard` and
opens a touch-first recording library. Select a WAV file to view its waveform
and play it, or start a new 16 kHz mono 16-bit recording. The recording screen
shows a live waveform and elapsed recording time, with pause/resume and finish
controls.
# mic_test

This command validates the demo88-nor onboard PDM microphones through
`/dev/audio/pcm0c`. The first capture milestone records mono signed 16-bit
little-endian PCM at 16 kHz and stores a standard WAV file. The default path
is `/data/mic.wav`, and the default duration is three seconds.

```text
nsh> mic_test record
nsh> mic_test play
nsh> mic_test loop /data/mic.wav 3
```

`loop` records, finalizes the WAV header, prints the resulting file size, and
plays it through `/dev/audio/pcm0p`. The app accepts both the stock nxrecorder
raw-PCM output and trees where nxrecorder already emits WAV, so no private
nxrecorder API is required. Durations are limited to one through five seconds
so the recording remains bounded for the 1 MiB LittleFS partition.

The capture lower-half uses two 8192-byte DMA periods. Its two explicit D13x
v1.x descriptors are 32-byte aligned, linked as a ring, and cache-cleaned
before DMA channel 1 starts. Startup logs print both descriptor addresses,
destinations, and links. An address-request failure additionally prints the
former descriptor and completed package count.

The custom D13x arch does not provide NuttX cache hooks. The vendor range
helper also emits its fixed-register T-Head cache instruction without tying
the loop address to that register. This lower-half therefore performs its own
32-byte-line clean/invalidate operations with an explicit `a5` constraint.
Continuous three-second capture and WAV finalization are board-verified.

## Stop Bug Findings

Recorder playback worker:

`contest2026_094_andy/app/recorder_app/recorder_app_main.c`

Flow:

```c
if (stop)
  {
    stopped = true;
    nxplayer_stop(player);
    break;
  }
```

UI clearly sets `stop_requested`, since status becomes `Stopping`.

`nxplayer_stop()`:

`apps/system/nxplayer/nxplayer.c:1813`

- Sends `AUDIO_MSG_STOP` into player MQ.
- Calls synchronous `nxplayer_jointhread()`.
- Playback thread receives `AUDIO_MSG_STOP`, calls `AUDIOIOC_STOP`, then sets `streaming = false` but stays in `while (running)` waiting for `AUDIO_MSG_COMPLETE`.

Playback thread code around:

`apps/system/nxplayer/nxplayer.c:1170`

```c
case AUDIO_MSG_STOP:
  ioctl(... AUDIOIOC_STOP ...);
  streaming = false;
  break;
```

Then waits for `AUDIO_MSG_COMPLETE`.

Speaker driver:

`vendor/artinchip/chips/artinchips/drv/audio/aic_drv_audio.c`

`aic_audio_stop()` around line 693:

- Sets `priv->started = false`.
- Stops CPU/DMA transfer.
- Completes active and pending buffers.
- Calls:
  ```c
  priv->dev.upper(priv->dev.priv, AUDIO_CALLBACK_COMPLETE, NULL, OK);
  ```

So theoretically upper-half should enqueue `AUDIO_MSG_COMPLETE`, but runtime proves this handoff fails or is delayed indefinitely. Result:

- `nxplayer_stop()` blocks in join.
- Playback thread remains waiting on MQ.
- Audio continues, likely lower driver STOP path is not reached or stop message is starved behind DEQUEUE messages.

- Player MQ can contain multiple high-priority driver `AUDIO_MSG_DEQUEUE` messages.
- Stop uses `CONFIG_NXPLAYER_MSG_PRIO`, currently default `1`.
- Driver callback messages may have equal/higher priority, allowing stop to sit behind continuous dequeue traffic.
- Need inspect audio upper-half callback message priorities in `nuttx/audio/audio.c` / audio upper-half.
- Strong likely fix: make stop message priority highest (`CONFIG_NXPLAYER_MSG_PRIO` greater than callback priority), check `mq_send()` return, and ensure player thread exits immediately after successful `AUDIOIOC_STOP` instead of waiting forever for COMPLETE.
- Since `aic_audio_stop()` synchronously drains buffers and sends COMPLETE, setting `running = false` immediately after STOP is reasonable for this board, but changing generic nxplayer behavior globally should be considered carefully.
- Better generic behavior: after `AUDIOIOC_STOP`, consume/cleanup or exit directly if STOP returned OK. The existing comment expects COMPLETE, but this driver synchronously completes everything.

## Current Task

User reported boot-time exceptions after the latest recorder playback-touch fix:

```text
exception irq=07 epc=3005c398 ...
exception irq=05 epc=30073f6c ... tv=00000018
```

## Root Cause Found

Addresses were decoded using current ELF:

- `0x3005c398` -> `hardware_initialize()` / `fs_initialize()`
- `0x30073f6c` -> `nx_vopen()` around `getumask()`

Disassembly showed `getumask()` dereferencing a NULL `task_info`, producing `tval=0x18`.

Actual root cause was SRAM exhaustion:

```text
_sheap = 0x3013fbc0
_eheap = 0x30140000
```

Only `0x440` / 1088 bytes remained for startup heap. Early allocations such as `g_pidhash` and idle `task_info` failed. Because debug assertions are disabled, initialization continued and faulted.

## Changes Made

### Recorder touch fix retained

`contest2026_094_andy/app/recorder_app/recorder_app_main.c`

- Playback Stop and Back buttons use `LV_EVENT_PRESSED` instead of `LV_EVENT_CLICKED`.
- Recorder UI always runs in a dedicated 16 KB pthread.
- UI thread priority is explicitly `120`.
- Playback thread remains `100`.
- CPU audio thread remains `90`.
- Recording remains `16 kHz / mono / 16-bit`.
- Smooth waveform code remains intact.

### GT911 priority reverted

`contest2026_094_andy/board/d13x/demo88-nor/src/gt911_input.c`

- Reverted explicit priority `130`.
- Restored `SCHED_PRIORITY_DEFAULT`.
- Reason: avoid unnecessary startup-stage changes while fixing SRAM root cause.

### Freed SRAM

`contest2026_094_andy/board/d13x/demo88-nor/configs/nsh/defconfig`

Changed:

```text
# CONFIG_LVX_USE_DEMO_CONTEST2026_094_MIC_TEST is not set
```

This is acceptable because user previously allowed disabling test apps, and recorder supersedes `mic_test`. Must preserve `tf_test`, Wi-Fi, LVGL, recorder.

### Added build-time SRAM guard

`contest2026_094_andy/board/d13x/demo88-nor/scripts/ld.script`

Added:

```ld
ASSERT((_eheap - _sheap) >= 0x1000,
       "D13X SRAM startup heap is smaller than 4 KiB")
```

This prevents generating future images that link but crash before NSH.

## Build Status

A full clean build was run successfully:

```bash
rm -rf cmake_out/demo88-nor_nsh
./build.sh contest2026_094_andy/board/d13x/demo88-nor/configs/nsh --cmake -j8
```

Result:

```text
#### build completed successfully (50 seconds) ####
```

The 4 KB linker assertion passed.

## Remaining Steps

1. Verify actual startup heap size:
   ```bash
   prebuilts/gcc/linux-x86_64/riscv-none-elf/bin/riscv-none-elf-nm -n \
     cmake_out/demo88-nor_nsh/nuttx | rg " (_sheap|_eheap)$"
   ```
   Compute difference and report it.

2. Confirm `mic_test` absent and `recorder`, `tf_test`, `wifi_test` present in builtin list or ELF symbols.

3. Copy build artifacts:
   ```bash
   cp -f /home/luisleee/Desktop/vela/cmake_out/demo88-nor_nsh/nuttx \
     /home/luisleee/Desktop/vela/nuttx/nuttx.elf
   cp -f /home/luisleee/Desktop/vela/cmake_out/demo88-nor_nsh/nuttx.manifest \
     /home/luisleee/Desktop/vela/nuttx/nuttx.manifest
   ```

4. Pack:
   ```bash
   cd /home/luisleee/Desktop/vela/vendor/artinchip/pack
   ./pack.sh demo88-nor d13x
   ```

5. Get SHA-256:
   ```bash
   sha256sum /home/luisleee/Desktop/vela/vendor/artinchip/pack/prebuilt/d13x_demo88-nor_v1.0.0.img
   ```

6. Update plan as complete and tell user:
   - Boot crash was SRAM startup heap exhaustion.
   - `mic_test` disabled to free SRAM.
   - Build-time 4 KB guard added.
   - Full build/pack succeeded.
   - Ask them to verify boot reaches NSH, then test playback Stop/Back.

## Constraints / Preferences

- Communicate concisely in Chinese.
- Full clean build and pack required.
- Do not regress smooth waveform animation.
- Keep old 16 kHz recording parameters.
- Preserve Wi-Fi, LVGL, recorder, TF/SD auto-mount.
- Do not revert unrelated dirty worktree changes.
- Use `apply_patch`.
- Known harmless pack warning:

## Current Task

User reports recorder playback Stop behavior:

- Animation stops.
- Button correctly changes to `Play`.
- Audio continues playing unchanged.

## Root Cause Confirmed

The recorder currently calls:

```c
ioctl(app->player->dev_fd, AUDIOIOC_STOP, 0);
```

However, NuttX `audio_stop()` in `nuttx/audio/audio.c` only forwards Stop to the lower driver when:

```c
(upper->status->state == AUDIO_STATE_RUNNING ||
 upper->status->state == AUDIO_STATE_PAUSED) &&
audio_getnstate(upper, priv) == AUDIO_STATE_OPEN
```

If this condition fails, it still returns `OK` after changing only the current open state. Thus the UI believes Stop succeeded while `aic_audio_stop()` is never called.

This exactly matches observed behavior.

## Relevant Driver Details

Actual speaker lower driver:

`vendor/artinchip/chips/artinchips/drv/audio/aic_drv_audio.c`

It implements:

```c
case AUDIOIOC_FLUSH:
  return aic_audio_stop(dev);
```

But `nuttx/audio/audio.c` has no explicit `AUDIOIOC_FLUSH` case. Unknown commands fall through to:

```c
lower->ops->ioctl(lower, cmd, arg);
```

around lines 1280–1295. Therefore `AUDIOIOC_FLUSH` should bypass the problematic top-half Stop state check and directly invoke `aic_audio_stop()`.

PCM wrapper forwards unknown ioctl commands to its lower driver, but verify this before patching if necessary.

- Back uses shared stop behavior.

Current problematic line uses `AUDIOIOC_STOP`; replace with `AUDIOIOC_FLUSH`.

`vendor/artinchip/chips/artinchips/drv/audio/aic_drv_audio.c`

  uint16_t target_vol;

  if (!haudio)
    return HAL_ERROR;

  ASSERT_PARAM(0 != (haudio->init.flag & HAL_HANDLE_ALL_INIT_FLAG));
  ASSERT_PARAM(haudio->regbase != 0);

  HAL_LOCK(haudio);
  if (haudio->init_cb)
    /* Should set input frequency and enable clock for AUDIO in callback */
    haudio->init_cb(haudio);
  else {
    hal_audio_clock_init();
  }
  /* Set audio volume */
  if (haudio->init.target_volume != ADUIO_DEFAULT_TAR_VOLUME) {
    target_vol = ADUIO_DEFAULT_TAR_VOLUME - haudio->init.target_volume;
    if (target_vol == 100)
      fade_val = 0;
    else
      fade_val = AUDIO_DEFAULT_FADE_VOL - (target_vol * AUDIO_DEFAULT_FADE_MAP);
    val = readl(FADE_CTL1_REG(haudio));
    val &= ~FADE_CTL1_TARGET_VOL_MASK;
    val |= fade_val;
    writel(val, FADE_CTL1_REG(haudio));
  }
  /* Set fade step */
  if (haudio->init.fade_step != AUDIO_DEFAULT_FADE_STEP) {
    val = readl(FADE_CTL0_REG(haudio));
    val &= ~FADE_CTL0_FADE_STEP_MASK;
    val |= haudio->init.fade_step;
    writel(val, FADE_CTL0_REG(haudio));
  }
  /* Set fade speed */
  if (haudio->init.fade_speed != AUDIO_DEFAULT_FADE_SPEED) {
    val = readl(FADE_CTL0_REG(haudio));
    val &= ~FADE_CTL0_FADE_SPEED_MASK;
    val |= haudio->init.fade_speed;
    writel(val, FADE_CTL0_REG(haudio));
  }
  /* Set DVC gain */
  if (haudio->init.dvc_volume != AUDIO_DEFAULT_DVC_VOLUME) {
    val = readl(TX_DVC3_4_CTL_REG(haudio));
    val &= ~TX_DVC3_4_CTL_DVC3_GAIN_MASK;
    val &= ~TX_DVC3_4_CTL_DVC4_GAIN_MASK;
    val |= (haudio->init.dvc_volume << TX_DVC3_4_CTL_DVC3_GAIN_SHIFT |
            haudio->init.dvc_volume << TX_DVC3_4_CTL_DVC4_GAIN_SHIFT);
    writel(val, TX_DVC3_4_CTL_REG(haudio));
  }
  /* Set filter shift */
  if (haudio->init.fltout_shift != AUDIO_FLTOUT_SHIFT_13BIT) {
    val = readl(TX_PLAYBACK_CTL_REG(haudio));
    val &= ~TX_PLAYBACK_CTL_FLTOUT_SHIFTN_MASK;
    val |= haudio->init.fltout_shift << TX_PLAYBACK_CTL_FLTOUT_SHIFTN_SHIFT;
    writel(val, TX_PLAYBACK_CTL_REG(haudio));
  }
  /* Set output and check output mode */
  audio_set_channel(haudio);
  /* Set SDM gain */
  if (haudio->init.sdm_gain != AUDIO_SDM_GAIN_1) {
    val = readl(TX_SDM_CTL_REG(haudio));
    val &= ~(TX_SDM_CTL_TX_CH0_SDM_GAIN_A0_MASK |
             TX_SDM_CTL_TX_CH0_SDM_GAIN_B0_MASK |
             TX_SDM_CTL_TX_CH0_SDM_GAIN_C0_MASK |
             TX_SDM_CTL_TX_CH1_SDM_GAIN_A0_MASK |
             TX_SDM_CTL_TX_CH1_SDM_GAIN_B0_MASK |
             TX_SDM_CTL_TX_CH1_SDM_GAIN_C0_MASK);
    val |= (haudio->init.sdm_gain << TX_SDM_CTL_TX_CH0_SDM_GAIN_A0_SHIFT |
            haudio->init.sdm_gain << TX_SDM_CTL_TX_CH0_SDM_GAIN_B0_SHIFT |
            haudio->init.sdm_gain << TX_SDM_CTL_TX_CH0_SDM_GAIN_C0_SHIFT |
            haudio->init.sdm_gain << TX_SDM_CTL_TX_CH1_SDM_GAIN_A0_SHIFT |
            haudio->init.sdm_gain << TX_SDM_CTL_TX_CH1_SDM_GAIN_B0_SHIFT |
            haudio->init.sdm_gain << TX_SDM_CTL_TX_CH1_SDM_GAIN_C0_SHIFT);
    writel(val, TX_SDM_CTL_REG(haudio));
  }
  /* Check samplebits */
  if (haudio->init.samplebits != AUDIO_SAMPLEBITS_16BIT) {
    haudio->errcode = AUDIO_ERROR_INVALID_PARAM;
    return HAL_ERROR;
  }
  /* Set samplerate */
  hal_audio_set_samplerate(haudio);
  /* Set output channel num */
  val = readl(TXFIFO_CTL_REG(haudio));
  val &= ~(TXFIFO_CTL_TX_FIFO_CH0_EN_MASK | TXFIFO_CTL_TX_FIFO_CH1_EN_MASK);
  val |= TXFIFO_CTL_TX_FIFO_CH0_EN | TXFIFO_CTL_TX_FIFO_CH1_EN;
  writel(val, TXFIFO_CTL_REG(haudio));
  /*Flush TXFIFO*/
  val = readl(TXFIFO_CTL_REG(haudio));
  val |= TXFIFO_CTL_TX_FIFO_FLUSH_MASK;
  writel(val, TXFIFO_CTL_REG(haudio));

  haudio->errcode = AUDIO_ERROR_NONE;
  haudio->state = AUDIO_STATE_READY;
  HAL_UNLOCK(haudio);

  return HAL_OK;
}

/**
 * @brief Transmits audio data through AUDIO interface in blocking mode.
 *
 *        This function transmits a buffer of audio data through the AUDIO
 * transmitter in a blocking manner, waiting until all data is transmitted or
 * timeout occurs.
 *
 * @param[in,out] haudio  Pointer to AUDIO handle structure
 * @param[in]     pdata   Pointer to buffer containing data to transmit
 * @param[in]     size    Number of units to transmit
 * @param[in]     timeout Maximum time to wait for transmission completion (in
 * milliseconds)
 *
 * @return HAL_OK on successful transmission, HAL_ERROR if parameters are
 * invalid, HAL_TIMEOUT if transmission times out, HAL_BUSY if AUDIO is busy
 *
 * @note This is a blocking function that waits until all data is transmitted or
 * timeout occurs. For non-blocking operation, consider using interrupt-based or
 * DMA-based transmission.
 *
 * @warning Do not call this function from an interrupt context as it uses
 * polling mechanism.
 */
hal_status_e hal_audio_transmit(hal_audio_handle_t *haudio,
                                const uint8_t *pdata, uint32_t size,
                                uint32_t timeout) {
  uint64_t time_start;
  uint32_t val, temp;
  uint32_t frame_bytes;
  ASSERT_PARAM(haudio);
  ASSERT_PARAM(haudio->regbase != 0);

  if ((!pdata) || (size == 0))
    return HAL_ERROR;

  if (haudio->state != AUDIO_STATE_READY)
    return HAL_BUSY;

  HAL_LOCK(haudio);
  /* Init tickstart for timeout management*/
  time_start = hal_get_tick();
  /* Set state and reset error code */
  haudio->state = AUDIO_STATE_BUSY_TX;
  haudio->errcode = AUDIO_ERROR_NONE;
  haudio->ptxbuffer = pdata;
  haudio->tx_xfer_size = size;
  haudio->tx_xfer_count = size;

  /* Clean TX counter */
  writel(0, TX_CNT_REG(haudio));
  /* Enable TX GLBEN */
  val = readl(GLOBE_CTL_REG(haudio));
  if ((val & GLOBE_CTL_TX_GLBEN) == 0) {
    val |= GLOBE_CTL_TX_GLBEN;
    writel(val, GLOBE_CTL_REG(haudio));
  }

  frame_bytes = haudio->init.channel == AUDIO_CHANNEL_MONO ? 2 : 4;
  if ((size % frame_bytes) != 0) {
    haudio->errcode = AUDIO_ERROR_INVALID_PARAM;
    haudio->state = AUDIO_STATE_READY;
    HAL_UNLOCK(haudio);
    return HAL_ERROR;
  }
  haudio->tx_xfer_count = size / frame_bytes;

  while (haudio->tx_xfer_count > 0) {
    /* Init temp first */
    temp = 0;
    /* Timeout check */
    if (TICK2MSEC(hal_get_tick() - time_start) > timeout) {
      haudio->errcode = AUDIO_ERROR_TIMEOUT;
      haudio->state = AUDIO_STATE_READY;
      HAL_UNLOCK(haudio);
      return HAL_TIMEOUT;
    }
    /* Check FIFO status */
    val = ((readl(FIFO_STA_REG(haudio)) >> 16) & 0xff);
    if (val == 0)
      continue;
    /* Audio channel check */
    if (haudio->init.channel == AUDIO_CHANNEL_MONO) {
      temp = (uint32_t)(*haudio->ptxbuffer);
      haudio->ptxbuffer++;
      temp |= ((uint32_t)(*haudio->ptxbuffer) << 8);
      haudio->ptxbuffer++;
      /* Write 16bit data to TX FIFO */
      writel(temp, TXFIFO_DATA_REG(haudio));
    } else {
      temp = (uint32_t)(*haudio->ptxbuffer);
      haudio->ptxbuffer++;
      temp |= ((uint32_t)(*haudio->ptxbuffer) << 8);
      haudio->ptxbuffer++;
      temp |= ((uint32_t)(*haudio->ptxbuffer) << 16);
      haudio->ptxbuffer++;
      temp |= ((uint32_t)(*haudio->ptxbuffer) << 24);
      haudio->ptxbuffer++;
      /* Write 32bit data to TX FIFO */
      writel(temp, TXFIFO_DATA_REG(haudio));
    }
    haudio->tx_xfer_count--;
  }

  haudio->state = AUDIO_STATE_READY;
  haudio->errcode = AUDIO_ERROR_NONE;
  HAL_UNLOCK(haudio);

  return HAL_OK;
}

*

#ifndef CONFIG_AUDIO_EXCLUDE_STOP
int nxplayer_stop(FAR struct nxplayer_s *pplayer)
{
  struct audio_msg_s term_msg;

  DEBUGASSERT(pplayer != NULL);

  /* Validate we are not in IDLE state */

  pthread_mutex_lock(&pplayer->mutex);
  if (pplayer->state == NXPLAYER_STATE_IDLE)
    {
      pthread_mutex_unlock(&pplayer->mutex);
      return OK;
    }

  pthread_mutex_unlock(&pplayer->mutex);

  /* Notify the playback thread that it needs to cancel the playback */

  term_msg.msg_id = AUDIO_MSG_STOP;
  term_msg.u.data = 0;
  mq_send(pplayer->mq, (FAR const char *)&term_msg, sizeof(term_msg),
          CONFIG_NXPLAYER_MSG_PRIO);

  /* Join the thread.  The thread will do all the cleanup. */

  nxplayer_jointhread(pplayer);

  return OK;
}
#endif /* CONFIG_AUDIO_EXCLUDE_STOP */

可以。Windows 网络共享（ICS）通常把有线网卡设为 `192.168.137.1/24`。

**Windows 配置**
1. 打开 `控制面板 → 网络连接`。
2. 右键有互联网的网卡（通常是 Wi-Fi）→ `属性 → 共享`。
3. 勾选“允许其他网络用户通过此计算机的 Internet 连接”。
4. 家庭网络连接选择连接开发板的“以太网”。
5. 运行 `ipconfig`，确认以太网 IPv4 地址。通常是：
   ```text
   192.168.137.1
   ```

**开发板静态 IP**
如果 Windows 是 `192.168.137.1`，执行：

```text
ifup eth0
ifconfig eth0 192.168.137.2 gateway 192.168.137.1 netmask 255.255.255.0 dns 8.8.8.8
ifconfig
ping 192.168.137.1
ping 8.8.8.8
```

也可以先尝试 Windows ICS 的 DHCP：

```text
ifup eth0
renew eth0
ifconfig
```

如果 Windows 以太网不是 `192.168.137.1`，例如是 `192.168.50.1`，开发板相应改为 `192.168.50.2`，网关使用 Windows 的实际地址。Windows 防火墙可能拦截对电脑本身的 Ping，因此 `ping 8.8.8.8` 更适合验证 ICS/NAT。
windows（192.168.137.1）的arp表有我的192.168.137.88。但我开发板ping外面没响应为什么

Windows ARP 表有 `192.168.137.88`，只证明开发板成功发出了 ARP，Windows 学到了它的 MAC；不能证明开发板成功接收了 Windows 的 ARP 应答或 IP 数据。

先在开发板执行并贴出完整输出：

```text
ifconfig eth0
ping 192.168.137.1
ping 8.8.8.8
ls /proc/net
```

`ifconfig eth0` 必须显示：

```text
inet addr:192.168.137.88
DRaddr:192.168.137.1
Mask:255.255.255.0
```

同时在 Windows 执行：

```powershell
ping 192.168.137.88
Get-Service SharedAccess
ipconfig /all
```

判断方式：

- 能 Ping `192.168.137.1`，不能 Ping `8.8.8.8`：Windows ICS/NAT 没正常工作，检查 `SharedAccess` 是否为 `Running`，重新取消并启用网络共享，确认共享目标选的是这块 Ethernet。
- Windows 能 Ping 开发板，开发板能 Ping Windows，但不能出公网：仍是 Windows ICS/NAT 问题。
- Windows ARP 有开发板，但双方都 Ping 不通：高度怀疑 GMAC 接收路径没有收到 ARP 应答。Windows 学到 ARP 只验证了开发板 TX，尚未验证 RX。
- `DRaddr` 不是 `192.168.137.1`：重新设置：
  ```text
  ifconfig eth0 192.168.137.88 gateway 192.168.137.1 netmask 255.255.255.0 dns 8.8.8.8
  ```

Windows 防火墙可能阻止 Ping Windows 本机，但不会解释 `ping 8.8.8.8` 也失败。需要看上述两次 Ping 的具体错误和 `ifconfig` 输出才能区分路由问题还是 GMAC RX 问题。

## Key Diagnostic Insight

Windows ARP containing `192.168.137.88` only proves the board transmitted ARP and Windows learned its MAC. It does not prove the board receives ARP replies or IP frames.

Interpretation:

- Board can ping `192.168.137.1` but not `8.8.8.8`: Windows ICS/NAT issue.
- Both directions can ping locally but no Internet: Windows ICS/NAT issue.
- Windows sees board in ARP, but neither side can ping: likely GMAC RX path failure.
- `ifconfig eth0` must show:
  ```text
  inet addr:192.168.137.88
  DRaddr:192.168.137.1
  Mask:255.255.255.0
  ```
- Windows firewall may block pinging Windows itself, but does not explain failure to ping `8.8.8.8`.
